+10.passive: Increases the damage of Bestial Incantations

notes: Increases the damage of Bestial Incantations by +10% when wielded.
→ The Clawmark Seal can be held in the other hand to stack the boost to +21%.
Has very good Strength-scaling.

→ While a pure Strength build may seem the best idea for this dagger this is somewhat compromised by the fact that it seems intended to be paired with the Clawmark Seal. Instead, a slightly uneven 60/30 split for Strength and Faith may be better to preserve most of the dagger's damage while still gaining good scaling on the Seal.

→ Having Quickstep as its skill is actually quite beneficial as it lets the user reposition quickly before or after casting a spell. Paired with alternating between quick casts of Bestial Vitality and swift dagger swipes and you have a decent setup.
This is the second longest dagger, being ever so slightly outmatched by the Miséricorde.

weapons.name: Glintstone Kris
weapons.japanese_name: 輝石のクリス (Kiseki no Kurisu)

skill.name: Glintstone Dart
skill.description: Skill that builds from the Glintstone Pebble sorcery. Charge the skill to upgrade it to Glintstone Dart. Follow up with a strong attack to chain this skill into a lunging thrust.

weapons.description:
Ritual blade once presented to Leyndell by the Academy of Raya Lucaria to celebrate their newfound peace.

Though the weapon is embedded with precious glintstones and features Erdtree ornamentation, the undulating blade is symbolic of an ancient ritual.

details: Received if siding with Sorceress Sellen against Castellan Jerren in Academy of Raya Lucaria near the end of her questline.

notes: Upgraded with Somber Smithing Stones.
Cannot have its Affinity and Skill changed.
Cannot be buffed.
Essentially a Magic affinity Dagger with a chargeable variant of the Glintstone Pebble skill and a much lower critical multiplier.

→ For comparison, an uncharged Glintstone Dart has 13% higher base damage on the projectile than Glintstone Pebble does and the charged version has 39% more base damage. This is on top of the Dart having roughly 6% stronger scaling for the bullet.
→ The follow-up attack is a bit closer: the Dart's has a higher damage multiplier and goes further, but the Pebble's has somewhat better tracking and adds some base Magic damage to the hit.
Receives the greatest Attack Power (AP) on a hybrid Dexterity/Intelligence build with an even split.

→ A pure Intelligence build could also be used to gain about 10% more damage on the projectile part of the skill at the cost of a 5% decrease in AP and of damage on the follow-up stab. This also focuses the dagger's regular damage more on Magic damage.
The skill is chargeable and thus benefits from the Godfrey Icon.
→ Note that this is only the projectile part. The follow-up thrust is not chargeable.
Has a unique, thrusting heavy attack compared to the standard daggers moveset. This trait is shared with the Main-gauche, the Miséricorde, and the Scorpion's Stinger.
The follow-up thrust deals 30 Stance damage, more akin to a Straight Sword's charged heavy attack instead of a dagger charged heavy attack which only deals 18 Stance damage.

weapons.name: Reduvia

skill.name: Reduvia Blood Blade
skill.description: Slash with the wicked dagger, transforming its never-drying bloodstains into airborne blood blades that cause hemorrhaging. Can be fired in rapid succession.

weapons.description:
Jagged dagger with a distinctive curved blade. Used by the noble servants of the Lord of Blood.

This dagger rips the flesh as it enters, inflicting blood loss with sickening efficacy. A proud testament to the success of its vicious design, this weapon is perpetually coated in blood.

details: Dropped by Bloody Finger Nerijus near Murkwater Cave after defeating him.

→ Beware that progressing through the game can prevent this invasion from happening, more specifically by defeating all the major Limgrave bosses (Flying Dragon Agheel, Mad Pumpkin Head, Margit, the Fell Omen, Tibia Mariner, and Tree Sentinel).

notes: Reduvia cannot be buffed by spells or any consumables.
Reduvia cannot have its Skill or Affinity changed.

Its skill, Reduvia Blood Blade, is essentially a version of the Blood Blade skill that costs twice as much FP and deals a little less Stance damage in exchange for not costing any HP to cast and having 50% more base Blood Loss (90 instead of 60).
→ Since this skill hits with both the projectile and the blade, it deals much more damage and inflicts more Blood Loss build-up when used within the dagger's range.

→ Ultimately, Blood Blade will do about 4% more damage at half cost with equivalent Arcane and an Occult affinity, making it the stronger alternative if the user is willing to stomach the self-damage and the relatively lower Blood Loss isn't a problem.
The Blood Loss build-up scales with Arcane.

Not counting the Wakizashi this is the strongest dagger for a hybrid Dexterity/Arcane build and the second strongest dagger for a hybrid Strength/Arcane or pure Arcane build, after the Bloodstained Dagger.

→ However, the Bloodstained's advantage is rather slight, only 8 AP (Attack Power) for the Str/Arc build and a mere 1 AP for the pure Arc build and the Reduvia will consistently have 10 more points of Blood Loss build-up.
The Bandit starting Origin has enough stats to wield this weapon without any level ups or stat-boosting equipment and items.

weapons.name: Blade of Calling

skill.name: Blade of Gold
skill.description: Leap into the air, charging the armament with golden flames that are then shot at the enemy as a single, blade-like projectile. Deals holy damage.

weapons.description:
Dagger given to one who set out on a journey to fulfill her duty long ago. The power of its former owner, the kindling maiden, is still apparent.

The one who walks alongside flame, Shall one day meet the road of Destined Death.

details: Hidden within a room that you can only reach during the elevator ride that leads down to the Forbidden Lands grace, alongside the Official's Attire. Jump from the southwestern part of the elevator to a doorway just above the bottom floor.

notes: Upgraded with Somber Smithing Stones.
Cannot have its Affinity and Skill changed.
While its Faith-scaling is technically the strongest its Dexterity-scaling is effectively almost equal to it because the dagger's Physical base Attack Power is higher than its Holy base Attack Power.
→ An equal split between Dexterity and Faith will give the most Attack Power (AP), though a pure Dexterity build or a pure Faith build will get only about 5% less AP.
→ Since the skill scales with weapon upgrade level and Faith but not Dexterity or Strength, it can be beneficial to lean into the pure Faith build, or even a 45/45 or 30/60 Dex/Fth split.

→ A pure Faith (80) build gives 1138 Holy Attack Power, 13% more Attack Power on the skill than hybrid Dexterity/Faith (45/45) build's 1010 Holy Attack Power and 5.5% more Attack Power than the skill of a Faith-leaning Dexterity/Faith (30/60) build's 1079 Holy Attack Power.

Unfortunately generally outclassed by the Black Knife. While this weapon is 0.5 units lighter, has better scaling, and its skill deals more outright damage at a lower FP cost, the Black Knife will always have more AP due to higher base Attack Power, is attainable much earlier in the game, and the skill is often more damaging due to part of its damage being percentage-based.
Has a unique double-hitting heavy attack shared with the Black Knife, Erdsteel Dagger, and Fire Knight's Shortsword.

→ This unique attack grants 20 points in total towards the scaling of the Winged Sword Insignias instead of the usual 10 due to hitting twice. This is enough to immediately gain the first bonus of the respective Talismans.

weapons.name: Black Knife

skill.name: Blade of Death
skill.description: Unleash the power of the Rune of Death to fire off a blade-like projectile. In addition to dealing immediate damage, the blade reduces the enemy's maximum HP and continues to wear down HP for a while.

weapons.description:
Dagger once belonging to one of the assassins who murdered Godwyn the Golden on the Night of the Black Knives.

A ritual performed on the oddly misshapen blade imbued it with the power of the stolen Rune of Death.

details: Received upon defeating the Black Knife Assassin in front of Sainted Hero's Grave located in Altus Plateau.

notes: Upgraded with Somber Smithing Stones.
Cannot have its Affinity and Skill changed.

Technically leans towards a pure (80) Dexterity build with its scaling, but practically speaking a hybrid (45/45) Dexterity/Faith build gains about as much Attack Power (AP) while also making the skill stronger since it only scales with weapon upgrade level and the user's Faith.
→ Effectively, the hybrid build loses about 2% AP compared to the pure build (494 AP vs 503 AP) in exchange for gaining about 13% more AP for the initial hit of the skill (969 AP vs 856 AP).
Despite its often resisted Holy damage this weapon still pulls its weight well due to the percentage-based damage effect its skill also causes, even when dodged through.
→ This health drain effect triggers even when rolled through so to fully avoid it can't be allowed to touch your body when dodged.
Has a unique double-hitting heavy attack shared with the Blade of Calling, Erdsteel Dagger, and Fire Knight's Shortsword.

→ This unique attack grants 20 points in total towards the scaling of the Winged Sword Insignias instead of the usual 10 due to hitting twice. This is enough to immediately gain the first bonus of the respective Talismans.

weapons.name: Smithscript Dagger

skill.name: Piercing Throw
skill.description: Throw armament with a powerful spin, causing it to bore through foes. When using this skill, the armament can be thrown further than normal and also pierce through enemies

weapons.description:
Dagger engraved with a smithscript.

Reduced mass enhances the effects of the smithing arts, allowing this weapon to function as a throwing dagger for all attacks.

Once thrown, the dagger instantly reappears in the wielder's hand.

details: Proceed normally through the dungeon until you reach the lever that moves the lava pipe and then drop down to the floor below. The dagger can be found on a body behind a Golem Smith.

estimate_if_undocumented.basis: 75 of 92 wiki-documented weapons with a non-unique skill use regular Smithing Stones

notes: Though subpar as a standalone weapon due to low damage and Status Effect build-up, the Smithscript Dagger is an excellent offhand weapon due to its very low weight, quick attacks, and decent range that lets it inflict small amounts of chip damage on opponents and potentially keep Status Effect build-up and Stance damage from decaying.

→ The available Ashes of War are better of selected from with the same criteria, with more utiliy-based skills such as Endure, Kick, Parry, or Quickstep fitting better than anything dependent on the weapon's Attack Power.
Every attack except for its Critical Attacks are throwing attacks, meaning this weapon benefits alot from the Smithing Talisman +10% damage boost.
→ The thrown attacks also partially benefit from the Arrow's Reach Talisman as while their range isn't increased the damage falloff experienced at longer ranges is decreased.

All different light attacks have an extremely low Damage Level value of 0 (No Stagger) and therefore are extremely bad at interrupting opponents, with one of the most notable conseqeuences being that it cannot break the bubbles that protect the Juvenile Scholars during Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon's first phase instead just killing them.

→ All different heavy attacks do at the very least a Damage Level value of 1 (Short Stagger), or 2 (Moderate Stagger) for the charged heavy attacks, meaning it is at least possible to interrupt these things with the correct attacks.
→ Note that this is not the same as dealing no Poise or Stance damage, even if the Weapon Class has the lowest possible base value of 2 for both of these.

patch_notes.official_notes: Increased critical hit power.
patch_notes.community_notes:
This is referring to the raw attack power of the critical hit and not the modifier; the critical hit modifier is still 100.
More specifically the innate multiplier for these attacks increased by 15-40% (from 220% to 280% for backstabs, from 300% to 420% for ripostes, from 420% to 483% for small PvE foes, and from 280% to?% for ripostes against large PvE foes).

patch_notes.official_notes: Extended the Smithscript Dagger’s throwing attacks range.
patch_notes.community_notes: With this update the non-skill attacks have a range roughly four times the original range.

patch_notes.official_notes: Extended the throwing attacks range for the following weapons: Smithscript Dagger / Smithscript Cirque.
patch_notes.community_notes:
Prior to this update the range of the non-skill attacks was extremely short, roughly 2 character lengths.
After the update the range is slightly longer, roughly 3 character lengths.

weapons.name: Short Sword

skill.name: Kick
skill.description: Push an enemy back with a high kick. Effective against enemies who are guarding, and can break a foe's stance. Sometimes a simple tool is the most effective.

weapons.description:
A short straight sword with a short blade. In addition to its reliable standard damage, this weapon also boasts powerful piercing attacks.

Lightweight amongst straight swords, this weapon is easy to wield, requiring only humble attributes.

details: Starting equipment for the Astrologer class.
Nomadic Merchant east of Saintsbridge for 600 Runes (x1).

4% drop chance off short sword-wielding enemies (Highwaymen, Godrick Foot Soldiers, Raya Lucaria Foot Soldiers, Radahn Foot Soldiers, Leyndell Foot Soldiers, Haligtree Foot Soldiers, and Messmer Foot Soldiers).
→ Murkwater Cave has many Highwaymen in a small area, making it a decent farming spot.

notes: Upgraded with regular Smithing Stones.
Can have its Affinity and Skill changed.

The default skill is good for dealing with enemies that are blocking, though it can also be used by simply switching to an empty right-hand slot or replicated by continuously attacking if the blocker isn't using a greatshield.
Has an entirely unique heavy attack chain consisting of only thrusts.

→ Since these attacks will reliably deal Pierce damage they pair well with the Spear Talisman for extra counter damage against attacking foes. Note that this works best with purely Physical infusions, as split Elemental damage (such as Magic or Lightning) will note benefit from the bonus to Pierce damage.
Surprisingly decent for the Magic and Flame Art/Sacred affinities, placing it closer to the middle of the pack than the end for damage.

When using its Keen affinity it actually has slightly weaker Dexterity-scaling for "bullet"-type (i.e. doesn't scale directly with the used weapon's damage) Skills with a Keen, Quality, Lightning, or Cold affinity, giving them usually about 2% less damage than they otherwise would have. This includes, as an example, the skills Beast's Roar, Storm Blade, Thunderbolt, and Hoarfrost Stomp (these skills however perform as normal on any affinity besides Keen).
Consistently the third weakest weapon in the type in terms of pure Attack Power (AP), outclassing only the Weathered Straight Sword and Cane Sword.
Quite short, the shortest of its weapon type in fact.

weapons.name: Longsword

skill.name: Square Off
skill.description: This skill starts with the sword held level. Follow up with a normal attack to slash upwards through enemy's guard, or a strong attack to perform a running thrust.
skill.attack_type: Weapon's Primary Damage type/Weapon's Secondary Damage type

weapons.description:
A straight sword with a double-edged blade.

In addition to its reliable standard damage, this weapon also boasts powerful piercing attacks. A superbly balanced armament.

details: Starting armament of the Vagabond origin.
Purchased from Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 1,000 Runes.

notes: Upgraded with regular Smithing Stones.
Can have its Affinity and Skill changed.
The default skill is useful for breaking the guard of blocking enemies with the light attack version or for breaking their Stance with the heavy attack version.
Consistently the second strongest of all regular Straight Swords, outmatched only by the Broadsword, almost matching it on a Keen affinity and outclassing it on a Quality affinity.
→ This may be somewhat surprising since the Longsword's scaling values leans towards Strength more so than Dexterity, but it's primarily because the Broadsword scales rather less well on Keen.
→ Quality affinity requires high stats to use properly, making this somewhat difficult to exploit before New Game Plus/Journey 2 and later.

While not quite to the level of the Short Sword's unique heavy attack chain, since the first heavy attack in a chain is a Pierce damage attack as well as the heavy variant of its default skill and as such can hit for heavy counter damage with the Spear Talisman.

weapons.name: Broadsword

skill.name: Square Off
skill.description: This skill starts with the sword held level. Follow up with a normal attack to slash upwards through enemy's guard, or a strong attack to perform a running thrust.
skill.attack_type: Weapon's Primary Damage type/Weapon's Secondary Damage type

weapons.description:
A straight sword with a wide blade, suited to slashing attacks.

Horizontal swing boast wide attack range, making it easier to connect with foes.

details: Starting equipment for the Confessor class.
Nomadic Merchant southeast of Coastal Cave, beneath the collapsed structure.

notes: Upgraded with regular Smithing Stones.
Can have its Affinity and Skill changed.
The default skill is useful for breaking the guard of blocking enemies with the light attack version or for breaking their Stance with the heavy attack version.

Always has the highest Attack Power (AP) of all regular Straight Swords, with the exception of the Quality Affinity, primarily due to its high base damage being able to compensate for its somewhat mediocre scaling.
→ Since it's acquirable extremely early, as soon as the tutorial is completed, this weapon is a useful tool for potentially the entire game.
Surprisingly, compared to its predecessors from previous game, this weapon isn't short but merely of average length.
Leans towards Strength for Cold and Blood/Poison affinities.

Despite having the highest damage and scaling on its Heavy affinity it actually gives slightly weaker Strength-scaling for "bullet"-type (i.e. doesn't scale directly with the used weapon's damage) Skills with a Heavy, Quality, or Fire affinity, giving them usually about 2% less damage than they otherwise would have. This includes, as an example, the skills Ground Slam, Storm Blade, and Flame of the Redmanes (these skills however perform as normal on any affinity besides Heavy).
Has a unique heavy attack and rolling attack, shared with the Cane Sword, replacing the usual thrusts with a broad, sweeping strike and an upward cut specifically.

→ This is mostly a disadvantage. While the unique heavy attack is mostly good, it lacks the Pierce damage of the usual Straight Sword heavy attack and thus can't counter-hit attacking foes, while the unique rolling attack is very lacking in reach.

weapons.name: Weathered Straight Sword

skill.name: Square Off
skill.description: This skill starts with the sword held level. Follow up with a normal attack to slash upwards through enemy's guard, or a strong attack to perform a running thrust.
skill.attack_type: Weapon's Primary Damage type/Weapon's Secondary Damage type

weapons.description:
Straight sword with a rather short but wide blade. Simple to wield, it was known as the sword of the people.

Though the Erdtree styling is still visible, time has not been kind to this sword, now merely a shadow of its former self.

details: Dropped by Commoner enemies with a 4% drop rate.

An easy spot to farm is the room with a Grafted Scion, where 3 Commoners are sitting next to a fireplace near the stairs to the second floor (an easy path there is taking the elevator next to the Rampart Tower Site of Grace).

A more complicated but also more efficient farming spot is heading southwest from the Secluded Chamber Site of Grace and, once up a small pile of rocks, turn around to the right and use a wooden platform to jump to a thin stone ledge. Jump to a dark room to the right and proceed along the path to a second dark room, full of Commoners.

notes: Upgraded with regular Smithing Stones.
Can have its Affinity and Skill changed.
The default skill is useful for breaking the guard of blocking enemies with the light attack version or for breaking their Stance with the heavy attack version.
The second weakest Straight Sword in terms of pure Attack Power (AP), surpassing only the Cane Sword.

weapons.name: Lordsworn's Straight Sword
weapons.japanese_name: 君主軍の直剣 (Kunshugun no Chokken)

skill.name: Square Off
skill.description: This skill starts with the sword held level. Follow up with a normal attack to slash upwards through enemy's guard, or a strong attack to perform a running thrust.
skill.attack_type: Weapon's Primary Damage type/Weapon's Secondary Damage type

weapons.description:
Well-crafted straight sword with an illustrious design, wielded by regulars of a lord's army.

Though blackened and damaged by years of use, it appears to have otherwise been kept in a serviceable condition, despite the soldiers having long since lost their minds.

details: Soldier enemies of every faction that wield this weapon have a 2% drop rate for it.
→ This includes Godrick Soldiers, Raya Lucaria Soldiers, Radahn Soldiers, Leyndell Soldiers, Mausoleum Soldiers, and Haligtree Soldiers.
→ Can be farmed from the very beginning of the game, at Gatefront Ruins, where some Godrick Soldiers wield this sword.
→ A more reliable spot can be found at Fourth Church of Marika, where two sword-wielding Mausoleum Soldiers can be found just outside the entrance.

notes: Upgraded with regular Smithing Stones.
Can have its Affinity and Skill changed.
The default skill is useful for breaking the guard of blocking enemies with the light attack version or for breaking their Stance with the heavy attack version.

The only Straight Sword besides the hard-to-get Noble's Slender Sword with an increase to Critical Attack damage. While it doesn't quite match up in damage to the stronger Straight Swords, i.e., the Longsword and Broadsword, this bonus lets it hit harder on Ripostes and Backstabs.

→ Compared to those two weapons, however, it's actually possible to obtain a second copy without starting as a specific class and it's far easier to farm than the Noble's Slender Sword or Warhawk's Talon.
Of the Dexterity-leaning Straight Swords this is the strongest one for the Cold affinity, if only slightly.

weapons.name: Noble's Slender Sword

skill.name: Square Off
skill.description: This skill starts with the sword held level. Follow up with a normal attack to slash upwards through enemy's guard, or a strong attack to perform a running thrust.
skill.attack_type: Weapon's Primary Damage type/Weapon's Secondary Damage type

weapons.description:
Narrow blade carried by wandering nobles. Made to be easy to wield.

Daubed with gold from tip to tail, it should fetch a good sum.

details: Dropped by Wandering Nobles that wield it with a 0.5% drop rate.
→ These specific nobles are distinguished by wearing the Aristocrat Garb (Altered) and Aristocrat Boots.
→ Sword-and-torch-wielding nobles will not drop the sword.
→ The Carriage on the road that runs north from the Agheel Lake South Site of Grace has several of these Nobles in its caravan.

notes: Upgraded with regular Smithing Stones.
Can have its Affinity and Skill changed.
The default skill is useful for breaking the guard of blocking enemies with the light attack version or for breaking their Stance with the heavy attack version.
The longest of all Straight Swords, with very good scaling but bad base damage making it a mostly good weapon, not counting how hard it can be to farm.
Performs best on the Keen affinity as it has the lowest damage deficit there and is usually only a dozen or fewer points behind in terms of pure Attack Power.

→ Despite this its Keen affinity actually gives it slightly weaker Dexterity-scaling for "bullet"-type (i.e. doesn't scale directly with the used weapon's damage) Skills with a Keen, Quality, Lightning, or Cold affinity, giving them usually about 2% less damage than they otherwise would have. This includes, as an example, the skills Beast's Roar, Storm Blade, Thunderbolt, and Hoarfrost Stomp (these skills however perform as normal on any affinity besides Keen).
As the description implies, this swords sells for 10 times as much as most other Straight Swords.

weapons.name: Cane Sword

skill.name: Square Off
skill.description: This skill starts with the sword held level. Follow up with a normal attack to slash upwards through enemy's guard, or a strong attack to perform a running thrust.
skill.attack_type: Weapon's Primary Damage type/Weapon's Secondary Damage type

weapons.description:
Beloved sword of an aged knight whose last quest was long behind him, repurposed into a walking stick. The tip is rather worn.

Though bent of back and without the brawn required even to raise the sword aloft, still he wished to meet his end with weapon in hand.

details: Found next to the stairs just south of the West Capital Rampart Site of Grace in Leyndell, Royal Capital.
Can still be found in Leyndell, Ashen Capital.

notes: Upgraded with regular Smithing Stones.
Can have its Affinity and Skill changed.
The default skill is useful for breaking the guard of blocking enemies with the light attack version or for breaking their Stance with the heavy attack version.
The weakest of all Straight Swords in the game, and of below average length on top of that. Slightly stronger on Dexterity-leaning affinities such as Keen.

→ Despite this its Keen affinity actually gives it slightly weaker Dexterity-scaling for "bullet"-type (i.e. doesn't scale directly with the used weapon's damage) Skills with a Keen, Quality, Lightning, or Cold affinity, giving them usually about 2% less damage than they otherwise would have. This includes, as an example, the skills Beast's Roar, Storm Blade, Thunderbolt, and Hoarfrost Stomp (these skills however perform as normal on any affinity besides Keen).

Has the same unique sweeping heavy attack and rolling attack as the Broadsword, and as such lacks attacks that deal Pierce damage when used on its own, only having the dual-wield backstep attack for that.
→ The rolling attack does come out slightly quicker than the regular version.

weapons.name: Stone-Sheathed Sword

skill.name: Square Off
skill.description: This skill starts with the sword held level. Follow up with a normal attack to slash upwards through enemy's guard, or a strong attack to perform a running thrust.
skill.attack_type: Weapon's Primary Damage type/Weapon's Secondary Damage type

weapons.description:
A sword that none can pull from its scabbard of cracked stone.

Relic of a lost civilization from a time long past, said to have served a ritual purpose at altars of light and darkness.

acquisition.location: Fog Rift Catacombs / Ruins of Unte / Ancient Ruins of Rauh
details: Found at an altar in either Fog Rift Catacombs, Ruins of Unte, or Ancient Ruins of Rauh. Since the altar in Fog Rift Catacombs is the most complicated to reach, it's recommended that the sword is taken there so that the later interactions with altars are less time-consuming.

→ WARNING: Once either the Sword of Darkness or Sword of Light has been acquired, though the two forms can be freely switched between by traveling to their assigned altars, the Stone-Sheathed Sword itself cannot be reacquired until you enter the next new game cycle.

→ Fog Rift Catacombs: From the start, follow the path so that you pass the first and second falling-spikes roofs to the elevator. Continue to the third falling-spikes roof and get to the other side of the room (be wary of the pit in the second saferoom to the left). Use the raised platform at the end of the room to enter the hidden compartment in the falling roof and ride it to a higher platform so that you can stand on top of the falling roof. The altar can be found in the opposite right corner of the room when on the roof.
→→ Picking the sword up here means it turns into the Sword of Darkness at Ruins of Unte and the Sword of Light at Ancient Ruins of Rauh.
→ Ruins of Unte: Found to the right inside of the courtyard blocked by an extinguished Furnace Golem (a Hefty Furnace Pot can get it going again to open the path).
→→ Picking the sword up here means it turns into the Sword of Darkness at Fog Rift Catacombs and the Sword of Light at Ancient Ruins of Rauh.

→ Ancient Ruins of Rauh: From Ancient Rauh Ruins, East Site of Grace, head across the bridge towards the west then continue forward until a small body of water and take a right. Take the Spirit Spring that is now straight ahead and jump forwards (north-northeast on the map) to a ruin underneath the large cliff. Here is a body with the Greater Potentate's Cookbook 9 on a pile of rubble. Standing at the cookbook with the Spirit Spring directly behind you, turn to the right to see a tower and a "broken" bridge (actually just invisible) that can be crossed to reach the altar.
→→ Picking the sword up here means it turns into the Sword of Darkness at Fog Rift Catacombs and the Sword of Light at Ruins of Unte.

notes: Upgraded with Somber Smithing Stones.
Cannot have its Affinity and Skill changed.

While the locked skill, Square Off, is rather generic for a Straight Sword, it's still very strong due to the guardbreaking ability of its light attack version and the heavy Stance-breaking of its heavy attack version.
A single sword switched between Sword of Darkness, Sword of Light, and Stone-Sheathed Sword forms always has the same level.

→ This means that if the Stone-Sheathed Sword is upgraded to +3 before switching to Sword of Darkness you will gain a Sword of Darkness +3. If it's then upgraded to +7 it will become a Sword of Light +7 when switched.

Note that all swords currently held in ones inventory switch forms when the respective altar is interacted with. Thus, the Stone-Sheathed Sword should be kept in the item box when interacting with the altars to switch another sword between the Sword of Light and Sword of Darkness forms.
There are few reasons to keep the sword in this form, as it's a fairly weak weapon that is only barely stronger than the Cane Sword.
→ It has one interesting quality, which is that it's a Straight Sword that inflicts Strike damage, which is strong against mechanical, armored, and skeletal foes.

→ Its scaling is quite different from the Sword of Light and Sword of Darkness, with its Strength-scaling at +0 completely outstripping either other sword's Strength-scaling at +10, and its Dexterity-scaling also almost does the same, and it has no Faith requirement. In exchange, its Physical damage is lower and it completely lacks Holy damage and Faith-scaling.

Though this weapon technically gains the most Attack Power (AP) from a pure Strength build, a hybrid Strength/Dexterity build with a leaning towards Strength works better since it barely sacrifices one-handed Attack Power in exchange for a slightly greater amount of Attack Power when two-handed.

→ For comparison (unmentioned stats are at the minimum required level): 80 Strength grants 459 AP, 60 Strength and 30 Dexterity grants 458 AP, and 45 Strength and 45 Dexterity grants 443 AP. Two-handing grants 488 AP, 503 AP, and 493 AP respectively.

weapons.name: Warhawk's Talon

skill.name: Spinning Slash
skill.description: Skill favored by dexterous warriors. Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.

weapons.description:
Talon-swords are affixed to the legs of Stormveil's warhawks, but this one has been repurposed for human use.

The blade is thin and lightweight so as not to obstruct the hawk's mobility.

details: 2% drop chance from Warhawks.
4 of these birds can be found on the walls outside of the Rampart Tower Site of Grace.

notes: Upgraded with regular Smithing Stones.
Can have its Affinity and Skill changed.
The skill, Spinning Slash, is potentially quite damaging, especially if it catches another player offguard and with low Poise, though it's somewhat hampered by the lack of reach on Straight Swords.
Strong leaning towards Dexterity, with damage barely lagging behind the Broadsword and Longsword on a Keen affinity.

→ Despite this its Keen affinity actually gives it slightly weaker Dexterity-scaling for "bullet"-type (i.e. doesn't scale directly with the used weapon's damage) Skills with a Keen, Quality, Lightning, or Cold affinity, giving them usually about 2% less damage than they otherwise would have. This includes, as an example, the skills Beast's Roar, Storm Blade, Thunderbolt, and Hoarfrost Stomp (these skills however perform as normal on any affinity besides Keen).
Has unique heavy attacks that hit twice, lending this weapon fairly well to the Status Effects of the Blood and Cold affinities.
→ Note that while the first heavy attack in the chain will always hit twice, charged or not, the second one will only hit twice if charged, and once if not.

→ This unique attack grants 18 points when one-handed and 22 points when two-handed towards the scaling of the Winged Sword Insignias instead of the usual 10 and 14 respectively, due to hitting twice.
→→ As the first tier of each Insignia requires at least 17 points to reach, either version of the attack will grants the damage bonus if both hits land.
→→ The first hit in the double-swipe grants 8 points while the second hits grants 10 or 14 points respectively.

weapons.name: Lazuli Glintstone Sword
weapons.japanese_name: ラズリの輝石剣 (Razuri no Kiseki Ken)

skill.name: Glintstone Pebble
skill.description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Magic affinity and the following skill:

"Glintstone Pebble: Skill that employs the glintstone sorcery of the same name. Follow up with a strong attack to chain this skill into a lunging thrust, performed while the armament is still imbued with glintstone."

Usable on swords as well as polearms capable of thrusting (colossal weapons excepted).

weapons.description:
A sword with a glintstone in its handguards. Wielded by the scholars of the Lazuli Conspectus who seek to master Carian sorcery. Deals magic damage.

Apparently once used as a staff of sorcery, this sword is made out of wood.

details: Dropped by Lazuli Glintstone Sorcerers with a 2% drop rate.
One can be easily reached just outside of the room with the Schoolhouse Classroom Site of Grace, just before the Red Wolf of Radagon in Academy of Raya Lucaria.

notes: Upgraded with Somber Smithing Stones.
Cannot have its Affinity and Skill changed.
The locked, innate skill, while not unique and reliant on its weaker Intelligence-scaling, is very strong for both the projectile bullet part and the weapon stab part.

Gains the most Attack Power (AP) from a hybrid Strength/Intelligence build (600 AP from having 45 Strength, 9 Dexterity, and 45 Intelligence), a bit less from a pure Strength build (579 AP from 80 Strength, 9 Dexterity, and 13 Intelligence), and even less from a pure Intelligence build (561 AP from 8 Strength, 12 Dexterity, and 80 Intelligence).

→ Note that since the projectile part of the skill is a bullet-type it scales with associated stat, in this case Intelligence, meaning that the pure Intelligence build will deal the most damage with that part of the skill, and that the pure Strength build will most likely end up dealing somewhat less damage overall with the skill.

Has a unique blocking heavy attack, shared with the Carian Knight's Sword. While this can make attacking into an attacking foe a bit less punishing, the resulting Stamina damage that will be taken if hit can prevent the user from attacking or rolling away.
→ While the brief hit-stun taken by shields isn't suffered when hit, the low Stability means that using the unique heavy attack is highly likely to result in a stun from being guardbroken.
→ Stability can be increased by 10% via two-handing and then further by the Greatshield Talisman.

→ While the uncharged unique heavy attack deals the same amount of Stance damage as a normal uncharged heavy attack, the charged version only deals 1.5 times more Stance damage instead of the regular 3x.

weapons.name: Carian Knight's Sword
weapons.japanese_name: カーリアの騎士剣 (Kāria no Kishi Ken)

skill.name: Carian Grandeur
skill.description: Carian royal prestige embodied in a skill. Transform blade into a magical greatsword and swing it down. Can be charged to increase its power by up to two levels.

weapons.description:
Straight sword embedded with a blue glintstone. Weapon of knights sworn to Carian royalty.

These knights' sword could serve as catalysts, letting them wield sorcerous battle skills. Despite numbering fewer than twenty, this power made them a match for even the champions of gold in battle.

details: Held by a Carriage located in the northwest region of Liurnia of the Lakes, between the Northern Liurnia Lake Shore and The Four Belfries Sites of Grace.

notes: Upgraded with Somber Smithing Stones.
Cannot have its Affinity and Skill changed.

The locked, innate skill, Carian Grandeur, while not unique and reliant on its weaker Intelligence-scaling, is still very strong if it can hit. Best used as a replacement for a Critical Attack or while lying in ambush since it charges somewhat slowly.

Gains the most Attack Power (AP) from a hybrid Strength/Intelligence build (616 AP from having 45 Strength, 10 Dexterity, and 45 Intelligence), a bit less from a pure Strength build (609 AP from 80 Strength, 10 Dexterity, and 18 Intelligence), and far less from a pure Intelligence build (576 AP from 10 Strength, 10 Dexterity, and 80 Intelligence).

→ Note that since the skill's damage is entirely reliant on the character's Intelligence and the weapon's Intelligence-scaling, the skill will be weaker on the pure Strength build compared to the other two builds.

→ Since the Carian Knight's Sword innate Intelligence-scaling is fairly poor, strengthening the skill and the sword's Attack Power together is somewhat difficult, with only the ease of upgrading weapons with Somber Smithing Stones over those needing Smithing Stones keeping it in front of regular Magic affinity weapons with this skill equipped.

Has a unique blocking heavy attack, shared with the Lazuli Glintstone Sword. While this can make attacking into an attacking foe a bit less punishing, the resulting Stamina damage that will be taken if hit can prevent the user from attacking or rolling away.
→ While the brief hit-stun taken by shields isn't suffered when hit, the low Stability means that using the unique heavy attack is highly likely to result in a stun from being guardbroken.
→ Stability can be increased by 10% via two-handing and then further by the Greatshield Talisman.

→ While the uncharged unique heavy attack deals the same amount of Stance damage as a normal uncharged heavy attack, the charged version only deals 1.5 times more Stance damage instead of the regular straight sword charged version which deals 3 times more Stance damage.

weapons.name: Crystal Sword

skill.name: Spinning Slash
skill.description: Skill favored by dexterous warriors. Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.

weapons.description:
Sword fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with intelligence.

The inscrutable Crystalians have but one clear purpose, to safeguard their crystals unto the end. One theory posits that they yearn for the return of their creator who will carve for them new brethren.

details: Found after the bridge in the Village of the Albinaurics Site of Grace, located in Liurnia of the Lakes.

notes: Upgraded with Somber Smithing Stones.
Cannot have its Affinity and Skill changed.
The skill, Spinning Slash, is potentially quite damaging, especially if it catches another player offguard and with low Poise, though it's somewhat hampered by the lack of reach on Straight Swords.
Does best as a pure Strength weapon, as Dexterity and Intelligence are somewhat hampered by having much lower scaling numbers and being based off the lower Magic base damage respectively.

→ For comparison (unmentioned stats are at the minimum required level): 80 Strength grants 652 Attack Power (AP), 45 Strength and 45 Intelligence grants 632 AP, 45 Strength and 45 Dexterity grants 624 AP, and 80 Intelligence grants 560 AP.

A good offhand weapon for those wishing to dual-wield Straight Swords on a Strength build with some Intelligence, due to the ease of upgrading weapons reliant on Somber Smithing Stones and its somewhat mediocre skill not mattering there.

weapons.name: Rotten Crystal Sword

skill.name: Spinning Slash
skill.description: Skill favored by dexterous warriors. Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.

weapons.description:
Sword fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. It festers with scarlet rot.

Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with intelligence.

details: In a treasure chest guarded by three Crystalians in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree, behind some large tree roots right after the Ephael Inner Wall grace.

notes: Upgraded with Somber Smithing Stones.
Cannot have its Affinity and Skill changed.

Effectively just the Crystal Sword but with slight Scarlet Rot build-up, much, much later acquisition, and lower damage from very slightly lower Strength-scaling and lower Physical and Magic base damage.
The skill, Spinning Slash, is potentially quite damaging, especially if it catches another player offguard and with low Poise, though it's somewhat hampered by the lack of reach on Straight Swords.
Does best as a pure Strength weapon, as Dexterity and Intelligence are somewhat hampered by having much lower scaling numbers and being based off the lower Magic base damage respectively.

→ For comparison (unmentioned stats are at the minimum required level): 80 Strength grants 625 Attack Power (AP), 45 Strength and 45 Intelligence grants 607 AP, 45 Strength and 45 Dexterity grants 599 AP, and 80 Intelligence grants 540 AP.
→ Has on average 25 less AP

A good offhand weapon for those wishing to dual-wield Straight Swords on a Strength build with some Intelligence, due to the ease of upgrading weapons reliant on Somber Smithing Stones and its somewhat mediocre skill not mattering there.

weapons.name: Miquellan Knight's Sword
weapons.japanese_name: ミケラの騎士剣 (Mikera no Kishi Ken)

skill.name: Sacred Blade
skill.description: Grants armament's attacks holy essence and fires off a golden blade projectile. The armament retains its holy essence for awhile.
skill.attack_type: Holy and weapon's primary damage type

weapons.description:
Sword forged by the servants of Miquella of the Haligtree, with a design modeled after those carried by Carian Knights. Instead of glinstone however, amber of the Haligtree is embedded in the blade.

A sumptuous piece, yet it has never been offered to any knight - an ill-starred sword with no master.

details: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree, near the Prayer Room Site of Grace.
After exiting the Grace in it to continue forward there will be a parapet on the right that leads to a tower with a ladder on the other side. Climbing that ladder leads to the sword's location.

notes: Upgraded with Somber Smithing Stones.
Cannot have its Affinity and Skill changed.

While the skill, Sacred Blade, is excellent, at this point of the game most bosses and tough enemies are resistant to Holy damage, and most tough Those Who Live in Death will have been defeated, making it far less useful than the much earlier acquisition of Ash of War: Sacred Blade is.

→ The bad +0 Faith-scaling actually means that Sacred Blade's projectile is weaker on this weapon than on an infusable weapon with a non-Sacred Affinity, to not even mention it in relation to a Sacred Affinity infusable weapon with Sacred Blade.

Has a unique heavy attack that causes the user to step forward. This attack has good forward reach, and since the first attack in the charged version makes a short dash forward it's useful to catch opponents out of their roll and for landing the Stance-breaking charged heavy attack while not having to stand too close to enemies.
This weapon gains the most Attack Power (AP) from a hybrid Strength/Dexterity build, as the Faith-scaling is mostly useful for increasing the damage of the Skill.

→ For comparison (unmentioned stats are at the minimum required level): 45 Strength and 45 Dexterity grants 605 AP, 80 Strength or Dexterity grants 581 AP, 45 Strength (or Dexterity) and 45 Faith grants 566 AP, and 80 Faith grants 516 AP.

→ In other words, 45 Strength and 45 Dexterity is best if looking to maximize AP while 45 Strength and 45 Faith (Strength is slightly preferable over Dexterity due to the bonus from two-handing) is better for a mix of attack damage and skill damage.
Pairs surprisingly well with the Golden Epitaph, another Holy sword that scales similarly well on a hybrid Strength/Dexterity or Strength/Faith build.

weapons.name: Ornamental Straight Sword

skill.name: Golden Tempering
skill.description: Cross the two swords to grant their attacks holy essence. While in effect, strong attack performs a dual-wielding combo attack.

weapons.description:
Slender straight sword patterned after an unique ornament. Superior swordsmen prefer to wield one in each hand.

After falling from grace, the dregs of the golden lineage sought power and purpose in the past.

details: Dropped by the Grafted Scion at the Chapel of Anticipation, either by beating it first try when starting the game or when visiting again through The Four Belfries in west Liurnia of the Lakes.

notes: Upgraded with Somber Smithing Stones.
Cannot have its Affinity and Skill changed.

The skill, Golden Tempering, is the only way to buff the weapon directly, adding a flat 100 Holy damage, and grants access to unique heavy, charged heavy, and running heavy attacks that are comprised entirely of thrusts.
→ These attacks always use both swords, even when using the weapon one-handed, so they can be performed even when something else is held in the left hand.

→ This means that it pairs very well with a shield that has No Skill equipped. While most Greatshields are functionally out of reach due to these swords having quite low Strength-scaling, the Jellyfish Shield and its skill, Contagious Fury, is still somewhat accessible and usable, even if having to first use the sword's buff and then the shield's buff is somewhat finicky.
This is a paired weapon, meaning it doesn't gain the effective 50% increase to Strength when wielded with two-hands but instead pulls out a second sword.
→ Since this weapon has below average weight for a Straight Sword, this essentially allows for dual-wielding at half the weight and upgrade material that would otherwise had been required.
→ Unlike how it usually is when dual-wielding, both light and heavy attacks will use both sword and blocking with the sword is still possible, if ill-advised.
Almost entirely focused on Dexterity, but still about 10% weaker than the strongest infusable weapons on a Keen affinity (Longsword and Broadsword).

weapons.name: Golden Epitaph

skill.name: Last Rites
skill.description: Raise the epitaph to grant the effect of Sacred Order to yourself and allies in the vicinity. Particularly effective at laying to rest Those Who Live in Death.

weapons.description:
A sword made to commemorate the death of Godwyn the Golden, first of the demigods to die.

Infused with the humble prayer of a young boy; "O brother, lord brother, please die a true death."

details: Found at the entrance of Auriza Hero's Grave. Requires a Stonesword Key to access and is guarded by a Basilisk.

notes: Upgraded with Somber Smithing Stones.
Cannot have its Affinity and Skill changed.

The skill, Last Rites, functions as an Aura Buff and adds 25 Holy damage and a universal 10% (5% for PvP) damage bonus, as well as a 100% damage bonus against Those Who Live in Death. While being an Aura Buff does mean it will stack with a lot of other buffs, it also places it in competition with Golden Vow (especially the spell version), which also adds a strong boost to damage negation on top of its damage boost, and the Golden Epitaph being Faith-leaning means meetings its requirements are easy.
→ However, Last Rites is generally quicker to use and doesn't require a Sacred Seal to use, making it possibly more convenient in combat.
This weapon has an innate 30% damage bonus against Those Who Live in Death (Skeletons, Deathbirds and such), on top of dealing the Holy damage that they are usually vulnerable to.

Has the most Attack Power (AP) on a hybrid Strength/Faith build or a hybrid Dexterity/Faith build, with a hybrid Strength/Dexterity build being a bit weaker, and a pure Faith build being weaker still.

weapons.name: Sword of St. Trina
weapons.japanese_name: トリーナの剣 (Torīna no Ken)

skill.name: Mists of Slumber
skill.description: Releases a faint purple mist that spreads across a wide frontwards area. This mist inflicts the sleep ailment upon foes.

weapons.description:
Silver sword carried by clerics of St. Trina. Inflicts sleep ailment upon foes.

St. Trina is an enigmatic figure. Some say she is a comely young girl, others are sure he is a boy. The only certainty is that their appearance was as sudden as their disappearance.

details: Behind a Stonesword Key imp statue in the Forsaken Ruins, Caelid, visible directly below the ledge at the Rotview Balcony Site of Grace.

notes: Upgraded with Somber Smithing Stones.
Cannot have its Affinity and Skill changed.

The skill, Mists of Slumber, is notable for being a strong tool for inflicting Sleep, both from the mist's 90 Sleep build-up per second and from the Weapon Buff it grants for 30 seconds, giving the sword another 20 Sleep build-up on top of its innate 66 Sleep build-up, 86 Sleep build-up total.

→ In combination with the innate Sleep build-up, a buffed Sword of St. Trina can make the notoriously strong-but-sleep-vulnerable Godskin Noble fall asleep in two hits. This is quite valuable since it is a very easily accessible and reusable tool for inflicting Sleep.

Gains the most Attack Power from a hybrid Strength/Dexterity build or a pure Dexterity build, while the Intelligence-scaling is largely useless due to being the weakest scaling (maxing out at 36% versus Strength's 50% and Dexterity's 72%) and scaling the much, much weaker Magic damage.
→ For comparison (unmentioned stats are at the minimum required level): 45 Strength and 45 Dexterity grants 542 AP, 80 Dexterity grants 533 AP, and 45 Dexterity and 45 Intelligence grants 490 AP.

→ While it can technically match the strongest Keen Straight Swords (Longsword and Broadsword) in terms of pure Attack Power, the fact that a considerable part of that is Magic damage (about 20% on a pure Dexterity build) hampers the damage a bit.
The Prisoner origin can wield the Sword of St. Trina immediately without having the level up any stats.

weapons.name: Velvet Sword of St Trina
weapons.japanese_name: トリーナの昏剣 (Torīna no Konken)

skill.name: Mists of Eternal Sleep
skill.description: Releases a velvety purple mist that spreads across a wide frontal area. Afflicts foes with eternal sleep.

weapons.description:
Silver sword of St. Trina, now stained the color of velvet. Inflicts eternal sleep.

When St. Trina was abandoned, the faint, light-purple mists coalesced into an intoxicating deep-purple cloud.

details: From the Fissure Cross Site of Grace in Cerulean Coast, head north and drop down two stone platforms to a cliff lower down. Inside of a cave to the south that's full of slimes is also the sword, furthest in.

notes: Upgraded with Somber Smithing Stones.
Cannot have its Affinity and Skill changed.

The skill, Mists of Eternal Sleep, has two parts. The first is a fine, purple mist that inflicts 112 Eternal Sleep build-up per second for two second that is also paired with a swing of the weapon. The second is a Weapon Buff that increases the sword's innate Eternal Sleep build-up by 15 for 30 seconds.
→ Since both of these parts happen at the same time, hitting both the sword and the mist on an enemy causes 127 Eternal Sleep build-up immediately.
Similar damage and scaling as the Sword of St. Trina, and since they both inflict Sleep build-up they pair quite well together for dual-wielding.

Scales best with Dexterity, but unlike with the Sword of St. Trina the Strength- and Intelligence-scaling isn't far behind, and its base Magic damage is far greater. This means that the sword deals roughly equal amounts of damage on a hybrid Strength/Dexterity build, a pure Dexterity build, and a hybrid Dexterity/Intelligence build.
→ For comparison (unmentioned stats are at the minimum required level): 45 Strength and 45 Dexterity grants 534 AP, 80 Dexterity grants 534 AP, and 45 Dexterity and 45 Intelligence grants 522 AP.

weapons.name: Regalia of Eochaid
weapons.japanese_name: エオヒドの宝剣 (Eohido no Hōken)

skill.name: Eochaid's Dancing Blade
skill.description: Infuse the sword with energy, then fling it forwards in a corkscrew attack. The sword continuously deals damage while violently spinning. Charge the attack to increase reach and duration of the spin.

weapons.description:
Treasured sword of Eochaid, a lesser, long-vanished domain. The copper coloration is not to be confused for rust, but is a conduit for its wielder to move it by their will alone.

Swords of Eochaid dance through the skies.

details: Found on a ledge at the beach bordering Caelid and Limgrave, to the east of the Third Church of Marika. It can be reached through the Gaol Cave or by using Torrent to perform some tricky jumps to ascend the cliff face onto its ledge.

notes: Upgraded with Somber Smithing Stones.
Cannot have its Affinity and Skill changed.

The skill, Eochaid's Dancing Blade, is both chargeable (benefiting from the Godfrey Icon) and actually counts for repeated-hits boosters such as the Winged Sword Insignias and Thorny Cracked Tear, something many other repeated-hits skills such as the Ghiza's Wheel's skill Spinning Wheel or the Ornamental Straight Sword's skill Golden Tempering's special heavy attacks don't.

→ It's however somewhat outclassed by the Marais Executioner's Sword when it comes to dealing damage with the skill, as the latter is a Greatsword and thus has greater Attack Power for the skill to be based off.

→ Since the skill's damage is based entirely of off the weapon's base Attack Power, and about a third of the Regalia's damage is Magic damage, Magic-Shrouding Cracked Tear and Terra Magica functionally give +7% damage and +7.5% (+5% in PvP) damage respectively if they can be set up beforehand.

Though both the Dexterity-scaling and the Arcane-scaling may appear equal, and technically are as both are valued at 0.66, the Arcane-scaling actually applies to BOTH the Physical damage and the Magic damage. This effectively places it as a mid-tier B-scaling (1.08 scaling instead of 0.66 scaling). However, due to scaling falling off around 54 points in a damage stat (see the Weapon Scaling page) a hybrid Dexterity/Arcane build holds up fairly well.
→ For comparison (unmentioned stats are at the minimum required level): 80 Arcane grants 631 Attack Power (AP), 45 Dexterity and 45 Arcane grants 618 AP, and 80 Dexterity grants 561 AP.

→ With a pure Arcane build this weapon will outmatch Occult affinity Straight Swords by 90-100 AP. As this is largely due to the innate Magic damage, this can be somewhat misleading in its performance if enemies are resistant to that damage type.

weapons.name: Coded Sword

skill.name: Unblockable Blade
skill.description: Imbue the cipher blade with light, extending its length, then strike with a sudden sweeping attack. This attack cannot be blocked.

weapons.description:
Hidden sword once granted to the Tarnished of the Roundtable by the Two Fingers. A formless cipher comprises its blade, which deals holy damage no shield can repel.

Champions would gather at the Roundtable Hold in days long past, when the Two Fingers were masters of oration, their flesh yet full of vigor.

details: The Coded Sword can be found on the upper floor of the Fortified Manor in Leyndell, Royal Capital, in the room that mirrors the one that the Two Fingers of the Roundtable Hold can be found it. This weapon cannot be acquired once the Tarnished has defeated Maliketh.

notes: Upgraded with Somber Smithing Stones.
Cannot have its Affinity and Skill changed.

As the name suggest, the skill, Unblockable Blade, will pierce through all the damage negation from a blocking shield or weapon. It also has a very wide reach since it's a sweeping attack and deals Stance damage on par with a Straight Sword's charged heavy attack, meaning it can break the Stance of most enemies within 2 hits and most bosses within 3 or 4 hits.
Unlike all other weapons, this weapon doesn't bounce away from any shield when wielded one-handed, not even when hitting the Ant's Skull Plate or sturdy enemies such as Miners.
→ Since this weapon has no Physical damage and instead is fully elemental, and its skill fully ignores all the damage negation of a block, it's not very wise to try to block it.

Since this weapon deals pure Holy damage it benefits fully from Holy-Shrouding Cracked Tear but is also heavily weakened if the fought enemy has high Holy Damage Negation, something that becomes increasingly common among Bosses after entering Leyndell, Royal Capital, with most of them having 40% Holy damage negation and 3 (technically 2) late-game bosses having 80% Holy damage negation.

weapons.name: Sword of Night and Flame
weapons.japanese_name: 夜と炎の剣 (Yoru to Honō no Tsurugi)

skill.name: Night-and-Flame Stance
skill.description: Hold the sword level and prepare to cast a sorcery. Follow up with a normal attack to cast the Night Comet sorcery, or a strong attack to sweep forward with a burst of flames.

weapons.description:
Storied sword and treasure of Caria Manor. One of the legendary armaments.

Astrologers, who preceded the sorcerers, established themselves in mountaintops that nearly touched the sky, and considered the Fire Giants their neighbors.

details: In a locked room at Caria Manor, Liurnia of the Lakes, which the Tarnished can jump into from above on the walkways where the Raya Lucaria Soldier puppets appear.

More specifically, starting from the Manor Lower Level Site of Grace walk out onto the stone walkways and take a left when they path splits in two. Follow the path as it turn to the right and look to the left when halfway across the last walkway. Search for a nearby roof to jump onto and then walk forward to find another roof further down. In one of the corners should be a ladder leading down into the inside of a tower with a chest containing the sword as well as a door leading outside.

notes: Upgraded with Somber Smithing Stones.
Cannot have its Affinity and Skill changed.

This weapon possess one of the strongest skills in the game, Night-and-Flame Stance. While holding the stance, the user is able to perform either a miniature Comet Azur with a light attack or a flame wave resembling the skill Flame of the Redmanes with a heavy attack.

→ Since both Magic damage and Fire damage have specialized ways to increase their damage (their respective Shrouding Cracked Tear, as well as Terra Magica for Magic and Flame, Grant Me Strength for Fire) it may be best to think ahead and try to specialize if you are about to challenge a tough foe or boss.

One of the main weaknesses of this weapon is the relative lack of other equipment that scales well with both Intelligence and Faith, which pretty much only the Golden Order Seal being a strong option. The Prince of Death's Staff (and the much harder to get Gelmir Glintstone Staff) has rather subpar returns for Sorcery Scaling when the two stats are below 60, making it only relatively good with Death Sorceries and rather bad with everything else.

It's possible to invest primarily in only one of the two stats, but it's ill-advised to do this beyond the early and early-to-mid sections of the game. This is because, while doing so lets you potentially hyper-specialize in one of the attacks and more easily overcome flat defences early on, it will also lock you into one element, and both the sword's own damage and the skill's damage doesn't scales all that well past 54 in the associated stat.

Just meeting the sword's requirements means that you will have the Intelligence to cast the Magic-boosting Terra Magica and the Fire-boosting Flame, Grant Me Strength, and just 1 more points in Faith will let the wielder cast the Golden Vow spell (which also boosts the skill since it's based of weapon Attack Power).

weapons.name: Sword of Light

skill.name: Light
skill.description: Unleashes the light carved in the armament's blade. Send the sword aloft to let loose a blinding light whose many rays sweep through the surrounding area. Also temporarily boosts one's own holy attacks.

weapons.description:
Sword of light, pulled from its stone scabbard at an altar.

From the quick of the root, unswerving rays of light intersect and reflect to give the silver blade form.

details: Take the Stone-Sheathed Sword or Sword of Darkness to an altar at either Fog Rift Catacombs or Ancient Ruins of Rauh.

→ WARNING: Once either the Sword of Darkness or Sword of Light has been acquired, though the two forms can be freely switched between by traveling to their assigned altars, the Stone-Sheathed Sword itself cannot be reacquired until you enter the next new game cycle.
→ See the page for the Stone-Sheathed Sword for all 3 altar locations.

→ If the Stone-Sheathed Sword was taken from Fog Rift Catacombs or Ruins of Unte the altar at Ancient Ruins of Rauh should be used. If it was taken from Ancient Ruins of Rauh the altar at Fog Rift Catacombs should be used.

notes: Upgraded with Somber Smithing Stones.
Cannot have its Affinity and Skill changed.

The unique skill, Light, creates spreading streams of Holy light in a cone in front of the user. This takes about 4 seconds to cast and increases the Holy damage dealt by the user by 20% for 60 seconds. Since this casts quite slowly, taking about 4 seconds to complete, it's best either used in an ambush to strengthen any Holy damage attacks used afterwards or cast before a fight to strengthen the opening strike.
→ As this is a Body Buff it won't stack with the vast majority of defensive buffs such as Barrier of Gold or a Boiled Crab.
→ Since the Sword of Darkness's skill, Darkness, works as a debuff that decreases enemy Holy damage negation these two skill work well together to greatly raise the damage of Holy attacks.
Has identical statistics to the Sword of Darkness. Only their unique skills and appearances distinguishes one from the other.
A single sword switched between Sword of Darkness, Sword of Light, and Stone-Sheathed Sword forms always has the same level.

→ This means that if the Stone-Sheathed Sword is upgraded to +3 before switching to Sword of Darkness you will gain a Sword of Darkness +3. If it's then upgraded to +7 it will become a Sword of Light +7 when switched.
Incredibly bad damage negation when blocking, even for a Straight Sword.

skill.name: Moon-and-Fire Stance
skill.description: Assume ready stance, swords imbued with magic. Follow up with normal attack to cast glintstone light waves, or strong attack to perform a spinning attack that bathes the area with flame. Light waves can have up to two follow-up casts with additional inputs.

weapons.description:
Carian light greatsword embedded with blue glintstone. Weapon of Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight.

Two swords as a single armament. When two-handing, a straight sword engraved with golden flame will be carried in the left hand. Here, and here alone, were moon and fire ever together.

details: Trade the Remembrance of the Twin Moon Knight, gained by defeating Rellana, Twin Moon Knight, with Finger Reader Enia.
→ Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

upgrade.changeability_info_source: wiki (Ash of War-Compatible Armaments) + deduced (affinity_changeable: wiki rule, a weapon upgraded with Somber Smithing Stones takes no Ash of War, hence no affinity)

estimate_if_undocumented.basis: 57 of 58 wiki-documented weapons with a Unique Skill use Somber Smithing Stones

notes: The innate skill, Moon-and-Fire Stance, is very versatile due to being a stance, functioning as a quick ranged attack with its light attack version and as a point blank blender with the heavy attack version.

Though Strength and Dexterity scales the Physical Attack Power of both weapons, the Intelligence scales the Magic Attack Power only found on the right-hand weapon and the Faith scales the Fire Attack Power only found on the left-hand weapon.
→ Each weapon having separate elemental damage types also means that the actual Attack Power per sword is actually about 20-30% lower than the number in the in-game menu.
If the Twin Blades is one-handed the held weapon varies: in the right-hand it will be the magic-infused Light Greatsword and in the left-hand it will be the fire-infused Straight Sword.
→ Despite looking like a Straight Sword, the fire sword functions mechanically like a Light Greatsword, meaning it will only dual wield if another Light Greatsword is held in the right hand.

→ If two separate Rellana's Twin Blades is equipped in the left and right hands both weapons will hold the magic Light Greatsword. This will also prevent dual wielding, with that button instead providing Straight Sword-like light attacks from the left-handed Twin Blade.

The wide variety of scaling Attributes also provides an equally wide variety of potential builds: one can focus on both Strength and Dexterity to maximize the damage of the weapon itself, on both Intelligence and Faith to maximize the potential of the skill, a bit on both Strength and Dexterity and more on either Intelligence on Faith to increase the melee damage while also focusing on one of the parts of the skill, or on all four stats equally to increase both melee and skill damage.

→ 45 Strength and Dexterity with 16 Intelligence and Faith grants 455 Physical Attack Power and 192 Magic and Fire Attack Power, 16 Strength and Dexterity with 45 Intelligence and Faith grants 324 Physical Attack Power and 233 Magic and Fire Attack Power, 30 Strength and Dexterity with 45 Intelligence (with 16 Faith) or 45 Faith (with 16 Intelligence) grants 391 Physical Attack Power and either 233 Magic Attack Power and 192 Fire Attack Power or 192 Magic Attack Power and 233 Fire Attack Power, and 30 Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence, and Faith grants 391 Physical Attack Power and 213 Magic and Fire Attack Power.

patch_notes.official_notes: Increased critical hit power.
patch_notes.community_notes: This is referring to the raw attack power of the critical hit and not the modifier; the critical hit modifier is still 100.

patch_notes.official_notes: Increased the attribute scaling of Rellana's Twinblade for lower Intelligence and Faith attributes.

A large sword with a straight blade. This heavy sword is usually wielded with two hands, but for those with enough strength, one is sufficient.

The hefty blade can be swung into multiple foes at once thanks to the broad, sweeping attack, making fending off crowds all the easier.

details: One is sold for 3,000 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant at the Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace.

notes: Notably stronger on Strength-boosting Affinities, such as Heavy Affinity, though it will always be third best to the Gargoyle's Greatsword and the Iron Greatsword in this endeavor: the Bastard Sword's primary advantages is how easy it is to get and how early it can be gotten, whereas the Iron Greatsword requires farming tough late-midgame to lategame enemies.

→ Despite this strong affinity for Strength its Heavy affinity actually gives it slightly weaker Strength-scaling for "bullet"-type (i.e. doesn't scale directly with the used weapon's damage) Skills with a Heavy, Quality, or Fire affinity, giving them usually about 2% less damage than they otherwise would have. This includes, as an example, the skills Ground Slam, Storm Blade, and Flame of the Redmanes (these skills however perform as normal on any affinity besides Heavy).
On the shorter end of the Greatswords.
Leans towards Strength for the Cold, Poison, and Blood Affinities.

skill.name: Lion's Claw
skill.description: Skill of the Redmanes, who fought alongside General Radahn. Somersault forwards, striking foes with armament.

weapons.description:
A large sword with a long, straight blade. This heavy sword is usually wielded with two hands, but for those with enough strength, one is sufficient.

In addition to the heavy sweeping attacks, it can also make a heavy piercing thrust, making this a versatile weapon.

details: Found in a chest in the castle. From the Castle Morne Lift Site of Grace and taking the elevator up, it's found in a building on the right, reached by climbing up the pile of bodies in the castle's courtyard.

notes: Its one- and two-handed heavy attacks and charged heavy attacks, and two-handed rolling attacks and crouching attacks consist of a thrust instead of the usual slam, making this weapon much more compatible with the Spear Talisman than other Greatswords and granting it slightly more range with these attacks.
→ This trait is shared with the Greatsword of Damnation Shadow of the Erdtree and Leontiel's Greatsword Tarnished Pack.
Though the Claymore has a higher than average Dexterity Requirement, it's overall more Strength-leaning in its scalings and will work better on Strength-focused Affinities.

Having Lion's Claw as its innate skill is a strong early advantage due to its immense strength and Stance-breaking potential, especially since the Lion Guardian holding the skill can be difficult to defeat without ranged attacks early on.

Significantly higher weight than other Greatswords.
Above average Guard Boost and Physical blocking ability, outmatched only by the Greatsword of Solitude Shadow of the Erdtree.

patch_notes.official_notes: Fixed a bug where the damage of the Iron Greatsword was lower than expected when an affinity is applied.
patch_notes.community_notes: The base Fire Attack Power was increased from 104-221 to 115-244 for the Fire Affinity and from 110-253 to 122 to 280 for the Flame Art Affinity, the base Lightning Attack Power was increased from 104-221 to 115-244 for the Lightning Affinity, the base Holy Attack Power was increased from 93-253 to 108-280 for the Sacred Affinity, and the base Magic Attack Power was increased from 97-253 to 108-253 for the Magic Affinity and from 83-176 to 91-194 for the Cold Affinity. The bug was presumably that the non-Physical Attack Powers of affinities had a lower multiplier than they should have been.
