→ Despite the letter-grades, this weapon gains the most Attack Power from a mix of Strength and Dexterity, which is slightly stronger than purely Dexterity due to their actual scalings not being that different and scaling falling off around 50 in a stat.

→ While Faith falls slightly behind the other stats, a hybrid Dexterity/Faith build has only 3% less Attack Power than a hybrid Strength/Dexterity build while having about 17% more Attack Power with the skill.

weapons.name: Eclipse Shotel
weapons.japanese_name: 蝕のショーテル (Shoku no Shōteru)

skill.name: Death Flare
skill.description: Set the lusterless sun ablaze with the Prince of Death's flames, inflicting the death ailment upon foes. Follow up with an additional input to bring down the armament, triggering an explosion.

weapons.description:
Storied sword and treasure of Castle Sol that depicts an eclipsed sun drained of color. One of the legendary armaments.

In Sol, the sight of an eclipse inspires a dreadful awe, preventing an onlooker from averting his gaze.

details: The Eclipse Shotel is in front of the altar inside the Church of the Eclipse.

upgrade.changeability_info_source: wiki (Ash of War-Compatible Armaments) + deduced (affinity_changeable: wiki rule, a weapon upgraded with Somber Smithing Stones takes no Ash of War, hence no affinity)

estimate_if_undocumented.basis: 57 of 58 wiki-documented weapons with a Unique Skill use Somber Smithing Stones

notes: The Unique Skill: Death Flare is a Weapon Buff which increases the weapon's Holy Attack Power and added Death Blight build-up to its attacks, which is useful since without it its Attack Power is somewhat mediocre.
→ Using the skill again in the middle of the buff animation makes the user use what is effectively a fully charged heavy attack with extra damage.
All attacks ignore at least 50% of a blocking opponents Guarded Damage Negation.
→ Heavy attacks and feint attacks ignore 70% of Guarded Damage Negation, and charged heavy attacks ignore 80% of Guarded Damage Negation.
Has unique, more horizontal heavy attacks and charged heavy attacks, and the charged heavy attacks also only hit once. Shared with Nox Flowing Sword and Shotel.

→ The heavy attacks are effectively pretty much identical to those of other Curved Swords, but the charged heavy attacks sacrifice a bit of the ability to gain boosts from the Winged Sword Insignias in exchange for taking about half a second less to perform per attack.
While both the Dexterity and Faith scalings have the same letter grade, the latter has roughly 33% stronger scaling compared to the former.
→ In spite of this, focusing on either Dexterity or Faith, or even a mix of both grants roughly the same amount of total Attack Power.

patch_notes.official_notes: Increased guard penetration
patch_notes.community_notes: Increased the base amount of ignored Guarded Damage Negation per attack from 40% to 50%. Also applied to a variety of other guard-piercing weapons.

weapons.name: Hefty Scimitar

skill.name: Spinning Slash
skill.description: Skill favored by dexterous warriors. Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.

weapons.description:
A curved blade of considerable size whose keen edge is only made more deadly by its imposing weight.

This curved greatsword demands both strength and dexterity of its wielder, rewarding those capable of mastering it with great, sweeping slashes that mow through multiple foes at once.

details: The Hefty Scimitar is the starting weapon for the Heavy Knight.
The Hefty Scimitar is purchased from the Nomadic Merchant in eastern Limgrave for 2,400 Runes.

upgrade.material_info_source: deduced (wiki shows the weapon accepts Ashes of War/affinities; somber weapons cannot)

notes: The Hefty Scimitar has the lowest stat requirements of all the Curved Greatswords and is one of the earliest Curved Greatswords that can be obtained, especially since the Heavy Knight starts with the weapon equipped.
The Hefty Scimitar is the only infusable Curved Greatsword that isn't an enemy drop, making it much easier to acquire than the others.
Above average damage, if somewhat short.

weapons.name: Dismounter

skill.name: Spinning Slash
skill.description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:

"Spinning Slash: Skill favored by dexterous warriors. Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack."

Usable on swords, axes, and polearms (colossal weapons excepted).

weapons.description:
This curved greatsword wielded by the brawny sellswords of Kaiden combines the blades of a scimitar with the heft of a hatchet.

A difficult to handle weapon that demands much of the wielder's strength and dexterity, but with practice and ability, it can serve as a versatile weapon even on horseback.

acquisition.location: Limgrave / Weeping Peninsula / Mountaintops of the Giants
details: 4% drop chance from Kaiden Sellswords.
→ Two Sellswords can be found apart on the path between Stormhill Shack and Warmaster's Shack in Limgrave.

→ Four Sellswords can be found at an unmarked camp northeast of the Agheel Lake North Site of Grace in Limgrave (the camp that contains the Armorer's Cookbook 1). Two of them are at the camp alongside some Wolves while the other two patrol around it on Horses.

upgrade.material_info_source: deduced (wiki shows the weapon accepts Ashes of War/affinities; somber weapons cannot)

notes: Overall, this is one of the easiest-to-get Curved Greatswords, especially if aiming for one with the standard Curved Greatswords' moveset and not one with unique heavy attacks.
Innately has a fairly even scaling between Strength and Dexterity, leaning somewhat more towards the former.
The second longest Curved Greatsword in the base game, though it also generally has the second lowest Attack Power of the infusible Curved Greatswords.

weapons.name: Omen Cleaver
weapons.japanese_name: 忌み子の大刀 (Imiko no Tachi)

skill.name: Spinning Slash
skill.description: Skill favored by dexterous warriors. Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.

weapons.description:
Heavy-bladed curved sword of colossal size awarded to Omen as a tool of war. This weapon is made to take advantage of brute strength.

The pattern etched upon the blade is the remnant of a deteriorative malediction. Indeed, when bestowing a weapon, preparations must be made for taking it away.

acquisition.location: Stormveil Castle / Cliffbottom Catacombs / Altus Plateau / Subterranean Shunning-Grounds
details: 4% drop chance from sword-wielding Omens.
→ One can be found just outside of hte Liftside Chamber Site of Grace in Stormveil Castle, sitting beside a Stray (a Beast-Repellent Torch can help keep the latter away to make the fight easier).

estimate_if_undocumented.basis: 75 of 92 wiki-documented weapons with a non-unique skill use regular Smithing Stones

notes: Has unique two-handed heavy attacks, charged heavy attacks, and jumping heavy attacks involving the opposite ends of the weapon in each hand and slamming down with it like a guillotine.
→ This trait is shared with the Magma Wyrm's Scalesword Curved Greatsword, and the Bonny Butchering Knife Shadow of the Erdtree and Butchering Knife Greataxes.
→ These attacks have 10%, 6%, and 5% higher Attack Power multipliers than their counterparts in the regular Curved Greatsword moveset.

→ The unique two-handed heavy attack has a combo with the Skill: Lightning Slash, where a Tarnished opponent hit by the skill's slash cannot roll away to avoid the heavy attack if it's used immediately afterwards.
Of fairly average length, but above average Attack Power.
Innately has almost equal scaling between Strength and Dexterity, though it leans more towards the former and performs better with Heavy Affinity than the others.

weapons.name: Monk's Flameblade
weapons.japanese_name: 僧兵の炎姿刀 (Sōhei no Enshitō)

skill.name: Spinning Slash
skill.description: Skill favored by dexterous warriors. Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.

weapons.description:
Curved sword with a flickering flame motif. Wielded by the Fire Monks who came out from the Mountaintops of the Giants.

The monks came to the land of Liurnia in pursuit of a fugitive who stole their fire.

details: 4% chance to drop from Fire Monk enemies that wield it within the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave. Note that it does NOT drop from any Blackflame Monks that wield it.

→ From the Site of Grace at the entrance, head further down the stairs into the Grave and take a right to find an illusory wall in the corner. Jumping through the furthest window in that hidden corridor, there is another doorway straight ahead, with a moveable flame trap to the right. If it has been lowered (easy with any ranged weapon or Margit's Shackle) then a sword-wielding Flame Monk can be found in a cubby on the right side in the corridor the trap was guarding.

upgrade.material_info_source: deduced (wiki shows the weapon accepts Ashes of War/affinities; somber weapons cannot)

notes: One of the shortest Curved Greatswords, and with the lowest Attack Power out of the infusable ones.

weapons.name: Beastman's Cleaver
weapons.japanese_name: 獣人の大曲刀 (Jūjin no Daikyokutō)

skill.name: Spinning Slash
skill.description:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:

"Spinning Slash: Skill favored by dexterous warriors. Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack."

Usable on swords, axes, and polearms (colossal weapons excepted).

weapons.description:
Curved greatsword of colossal size forged of dull iron and wielded by the beastmen of Farum Azula.

The blade is incredibly heavy, but well-balanced. Comparatively easy to wield for the damage it delivers. It's clear the beastmen possess knowledge beyond human ken.

acquisition.location: The Four Belfries / Crumbling Farum Azula
details: 2% drop chance from Cleaver-wielding Beastmen.

→ It can be found at the earliest by taking the "Crumbling Lands" Waygate at The Four Belfries, alongside a throwing knife-wielding one. These will be scaled for Farum Azula rather than Liurnia, so they are considerably tougher than any other regular enemy at that point of the game and the mix of range and melee make them quite difficult to take on.
→ In Farum Azula, taking the elevator next to the Beside the Great Bridge Site of Grace back down leads to a walking cleaver-wielder with its back turned, though it is the stronger.

→ Another two can be found by taking the lift down beside the Dragon Temple Lift Site of Grace exiting out the room to the right, with the first being down the stairs straight ahead and the second being reached by walking up a floating pillar to the right (though the second one is also guardd by a sword-wielding Beastman at the pillar and a Stray behind a wall near its position).

upgrade.material_info_source: deduced (wiki shows the weapon accepts Ashes of War/affinities; somber weapons cannot)

notes: The second shortest Curved Greatsword in the base game, but also consistently one of the strongest ones (and outright the strongest infusable one).

When using its Heavy affinity it actually has slightly weaker Strength-scaling for "bullet"-type (i.e. doesn't scale directly with the used weapon's damage) Skills with a Heavy, Quality, or Fire Affinity, giving them usually about 2% less damage than they otherwise would have. This includes, as an example, the skills Ground Slam, Storm Blade, and Flame of the Redmanes (these skills however perform as normal on any affinity besides Heavy).
Has surprisingly high Physical Guard Damage Negation and Guard Boost for a weapon, enough to be fairly usable for Guard Counters on its own.

weapons.name: Freyja's Greatsword
weapons.japanese_name: フレイヤの大剣 (Fureiya no Taiken)

skill.name: Spinning Slash
skill.description: Skill favored by dexterous warriors. Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.

weapons.description:
Weapon of Freyja, a Redmane. Greatsword decorated with a mane, much like the weapons used by her liege.

The spirit of Freyja's training lingers in this sword, enhancing the power of Redmane battle skills.

details: This weapon can be obtained wherever Redmane Freyja dies.
→ If you gave her Freyja's Letter, you can find Freyja's Greatsword on her body after defeating her during the boss against Needle Knight Leda and her allies.
→ Otherwise, it can be found by the Storehouse, Seventh Floor Site of Grace after defeating Leda and her allies.

estimate_if_undocumented.basis: 75 of 92 wiki-documented weapons with a non-unique skill use regular Smithing Stones

notes: The Attack Power of the following Redmane skills is increased by 10% (7% against other players) when this weapon is held in one of a player's two active hand slots: Flame of the Redmanes, Lion's Claw, Roaring Bash, and Savage Lion's Claw.
On a pure Strength build, a Heavy-infused Freyja's Greatsword is the second-strongest Curved Greatsword in the game, just barely losing to a Heavy-infused Beastman's Cleaver by around ~20 AP.

weapons.name: Bloodhound's Fang

skill.name: Bloodhound's Finesse
skill.description: Slash upwards with the Bloodhound's Fang, using the momentum of the strike to perform a backwards somersault and gain some distance from foes. Follow up with a strong attack to perform the Bloodhound's Step attack.

weapons.description:
Curved greatsword with a gently undulating blade wielded by Bloodhound Knights.

A fearsome blade capable of brutal airborne attacks.

details: Dropped by Bloodhound Knight Darriwil in the Forlorn Hound Evergaol in southern Limgrave.
→ Blaidd the Half-Wolf will direct the Tarnished here as part of his questline, and will be available for summoning in the Evergaol before awakening Darriwil after doing so.

upgrade.changeability_info_source: wiki rule (Ashes of War cannot be applied to weapons upgraded with Somber Smithing Stones)

notes: The Unique Skill: Bloodhound's Finesse is an extremely strong two-part attack that also has some defensive use as it dashes backwards with the initial attack and then has Invincibility Frames with the follow-up attack, though it does have the downside of being somewhat hard to control and being parryable.
Bloodhound's Fang is one of only two Somber Smithing Stone-based weapons that can receive Weapon Buffs.

→ Bloodflame Blade is generally the strongest option for this, as the combination of extra Fire Attack Power and additional Blood Loss build-up is quite good for a fairly small investment in Faith and Arcane required to cast it.

As implied in the description, the jump attacks of Bloodhound's Fang deal much more damage when compared to the jump attacks of the same weapon class. This is due to the jump attacks of the Bloodhound's Fang having higher motion values than usual.

→ The motion values for all four jump attacks on the Bloodhound's Fang are 118% (one-handed jumping light attacks), 142% (one-handed jumping heavy attacks), 128% (two-handed jumping light attacks) and 151% (two-handed jumping heavy attacks). The typical motion values on Curved Greatswords for these same attacks are 107%, 127%, 112% and 132%.
→ Curiously, dual-wield jumping attacks with the Bloodhound's Fang do not receive this boost.
As the scaling letters imply, this weapon scales the best with Dexterity though an even split of Strength and Dexterity gives almost equal results, especially when two-handed.

patch_notes.official_notes: Fixed a bug which made it harder for a two-handed jump attack with “Bloodhound's Fang” to break enemy’s stance.

weapons.name: Onyx Lord's Greatsword

skill.name: Onyx Lord's Repulsion
skill.description: Thrust the armament into the ground to create a gravity well. In addition to dealing damage, this attack sends enemies flying away.

weapons.description:
Greatsword forged from golden-hued meteoric ore. The blade conceals gravity-manipulating magic.

A weapon unique to the Onyx Lords, a race of ancients with skin of stone who were said to have risen to life when a meteor struck long ago.

details: Dropped by the Onyx Lord boss at the end of the Sealed Tunnel in Capital Outskirts.

notes: Cannot be buffed or infused with Ashes of War.
The Unique Skill: Onyx Lord's Repulsion is effectively an inverted and stronger version of the Skill: Gravitas, throwing enemies away instead of bringing them closer.
Deals an extra 20% damage against Gravity-type enemies.

The scaling values for Strength and Intelligence are actually the same, but since the base Physical damage that the former scales is greater than the base Magic damage that the latter scales, Strength will be much more valuable until it reaches 40. After that they are roughly equal until Strength reaches 80 (54 if two-handing) and Intelligence reaches 50.

→ Intelligence does also increase the Attack Power of the skill's magical explosions, with 30 Intelligence increasing the Attack Power by 16% compared to 16 Intelligence and 45 Intelligence increasing it by a total of 36% comparatively.

weapons.name: Zamor Curved Sword
weapons.japanese_name: ザミェルの湾刀 (Zamyeru no Wantō)

skill.name: Zamor Ice Storm
skill.description: Plunge the curved sword into the ground, building power before unleashing a freezing storm that batters the surroundings.

weapons.description:
Weapon wielded by the knights of Zamor who earned great renown during the War against the Giants.

In apparent devotion to winter, the curved blade is styled after an icy wind and imbued with a powerful frost effect.

details: Dropped by the Ancient Hero of Zamor boss at the end of the Hero's Grave.

upgrade.changeability_info_source: wiki (Ash of War-Compatible Armaments) + deduced (affinity_changeable: wiki rule, a weapon upgraded with Somber Smithing Stones takes no Ash of War, hence no affinity)

estimate_if_undocumented.basis: 57 of 58 wiki-documented weapons with a Unique Skill use Somber Smithing Stones

notes: The Unique Skill: Zamor Ice Storm is a good close-range area attack that can effectively lock off a small area for a few seconds, and can potentially roll catch opponents.

→ The damage of the tornado part only scales with the Zamor Curved Sword's upgrade level (it technically would scales with the wielder's Intelligence, but since the Zamor Curved Sword has no Intelligence scaling it's nullified).

Has unique, twirling one- and two-handed light attacks that are slightly slower but deal more damage (100%, 104%, 108%, and 120% Attack Power instead of the standard 100%, 102%, 104%, and 110% Attack Power.

→ To be more specific, for the one-handed light attacks the first attack comes out 1 frame/0.03 seconds slower, the seconds 3 frames/0.10 seconds slower, the third 5 frames/0.17 seconds slower, and the fourth 9 frames/0.30 seconds slower, while for the two-handed light attacks the first attack comes out 1 frames/0.03 seconds slower, the second 2 frames/0.07 seconds slower, 3 frames/0.10 seconds slower, and 6 frames/0.20 seconds slower.

Technically scales better with Dexterity than with Strength but the difference is small enough that a hybrid Strength/Dexterity build gains somewhat more Attack Power than a pure Dexterity build, which in turn gains a bit more Attack Power than a pure Strength build.
By far the shortest Curved Greatsword.

patch_notes.official_notes: Increased damage. Increased movement distance of some attacks.
patch_notes.community_notes: Increased base Attack Power from 125 to 130 at +0 and from 306 to 318 at +10. ----
Increased Physical Guard Damage Negation from 61% to 67%.

weapons.name: Magma Wyrm's Scalesword

skill.name: Magma Guillotine
skill.description: Grab the scalesword with both hands, as a wyrm would hold it in its mouth, and leap forwards, smashing it into the ground and triggering a blast of magma. Follow up with an additional input to perform a chopping attack.

weapons.description:
Curved greatsword wielded by Magma Wyrms. The shape resembles a dragon's jaw and is covered in hard scales.

It's said these land-bound dragons were once human heroes who partook in dragon communion, a grave transgression for which they were cursed to crawl the earth upon their bellies, shadows of their former selves.

details: Received upon defeating Magma Wyrm Makar at the end of the dungeon.

notes: The Magma Wyrm's Scalesword cannot be buffed by spells or any consumables.
The Magma Wyrm's Scalesword cannot have its Ash of War or Affinity changed.

The Unique Skill: Magma Guillotine makes the wielder jump into the air and slam the Magma Wyrm's Scalesword into the ground, creating a pool of magma upon impact. Pressing the skill button again causes a follow-up attack where the wielder chops the ground again.
→ Magma Guillotine has incredible Super Armor, making it almost impossible to interrupt.
Has unique two-handed heavy attacks, charged heavy attacks, and jumping heavy attacks involving the opposite ends of the weapon in each hand and slamming down with it like a guillotine.
→ This trait is shared with the Omen Cleaver Curved Greatsword, and the Bonny Butchering Knife Shadow of the Erdtree and Butchering Knife Greataxes.
→ These attacks have 10%, 6%, and 5% higher Attack Power multipliers than their counterparts in the regular Curved Greatsword moveset.
Increasing Strength or Dexterity increases Physical Attack Power while increasing Faith will only increase the Fire Attack Power.

→ Leveling up Strength yields higher results towards the weapon's Attack Power than leveling up Faith which yields a higher result than Dexterity. For builds that want to use the Magma Wyrm's Scalesword, it is therefore recommended to primarily focus on leveling up Strength before investing further into Faith in order to grant the best possible AR.
→ This scaling gives strong synergy with the Strength- and Faith-scaling Clawmark Seal for access to offensive Incantations such as Flame Sling or Flame, Grant Me Strength.

weapons.name: Horned Warrior's Greatsword
weapons.japanese_name: 角の戦士の大曲剣 (Tsuno no Senshi no Daikyokken)

skill.name: Horn Calling: Storm
skill.description: Invokes tangled horns to cover the weapon's blade. Call a storm into the horns, then mow through enemies. Additional inputs allow for up to two follow-up attacks.

weapons.description:
Curved greatsword of the horned warriors, keepers of the tower. A heavy weapon made to bring the deft strength of the warriors to bear.

The ornamental tangled horns allow the blade to serve as a medium for horn-calling.

details: Obtained from the Wind-aspected Divine Beast Warrior found towards the end of Enir-Ilim on the bridge to the Cleansing Chamber Anteroom Site of Grace.

upgrade.changeability_info_source: wiki (Ash of War-Compatible Armaments) + deduced (affinity_changeable: wiki rule, a weapon upgraded with Somber Smithing Stones takes no Ash of War, hence no affinity)

estimate_if_undocumented.basis: 57 of 58 wiki-documented weapons with a Unique Skill use Somber Smithing Stones

notes: Unique Skill: Horn Calling: Storm is a long range, powerful melee attack that has the ability to knock opponents to the ground.
→ Like its Ash of War-counterpart, the Skill: Stormcaller, this also provides strong area control, especially in small, confined rooms.
Just like the Horned Warrior's Sword, this weapon's Physical Attack Power scales with Strength, Dexterity, and Faith.

→ Dexterity and Faith has equal scaling, while Strength is twice as strong as the other two. Overall, a pure Strength build, a hybrid Strength/Dexterity build, and a hybrid Strength/Faith build all grant roughly the same amount of Attack Power when two-handed, with pure Strength being in the lead for one-handed usage.

→ Faith does grant access to buffing Incantations and will strengthen the strong weapon spins of the skill, but this is a slight advantage and only really makes it worth it to invest a few points in the stat.

weapons.name: Morgott's Cursed Sword
weapons.japanese_name: モーゴットの呪剣 (Mōgotto no Juken)

skill.name: Cursed-Blood Slice
skill.description: Brace, then charge forward to deliver a downward diagonal slice. The bloody trail of the blade is followed by a burst of flame. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.

weapons.description:
Warped blade of shifting hue used by Morgott, the Omen King.

The accursed blood that Morgott recanted and sealed away reformed into this blade.

details: Trade the Remembrance of the Omen King, gained by defeating the Morgott, the Omen King, with Finger Reader Enia.
→ Alternatively, use one of the belled Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

notes: Morgott's Cursed Sword cannot be buffed by spells or any consumables.
Morrgott's Cursed Sword cannot have its Skill or its Affinity changed.
The Unique Skill: Cursed-Blood Slice is a dashing attack with a follow-up attack, both of which bloodflame which can be used to inflict Blood Loss.
Arcane scales both the Physical Attack Power (as does Strength and Dexterity) and the Blood Loss of the sword, and the Fire Attack Power of the skill's attacks.

→ A pure Dexterity build will grant the highest Attack Power for the weapon, but a hybrid Dexterity/Arcane build will provide a slight boost to Blood Loss build-up (at +10 it will be 84 build-up at 45 Arcane compared to the 62 build-up at the bare minimum 17 Arcane) and the additional Fire Attack Power of the skill.
This is the only Curved Greatsword with improved Critical Attacks, with a Critical Rating of 110 instead of the standard 100.
Morgott's Cursed Sword has the longest reach out of all the Curved Greatswords.

weapons.name: Reverse-Bladed Sword
weapons.japanese_name: 逆刃の曲剣 (Gyaku Ha no Kyoku Ken)

skill.name: Blind Spot
skill.description: Leap into close quarters to take advantage of the enemy's blind spot and gore them from the side. Inputs determine which side you strike from. This attack slips below the opponent's guard.

weapons.description:
Curved blade wielded with a backhand grip, said to have originated from the hidden realm of shadow.

The style of combat associated with this weapon is marked by spinning slashes and gouging thrust attacks.

details: Sold by the Twin Maiden Husks at Roundtable Hold for 1,000 Runes. Tarnished Pack

estimate_if_undocumented.basis: 75 of 92 wiki-documented weapons with a non-unique skill use regular Smithing Stones

notes: When compared to the Backhand Blade, the Reverse-Bladed Sword has higher base damage and lower stat requirements, but has worse scaling, and weighs a tad more. The real advantage of the Reverse-Bladed Sword is being able to obtain a Backhand Blade without having to traverse to the Realm of Shadow.
→ It also shares the previously unique quality of inflicting Pierce damage with some of its attacks, which the other Backhand Blades don't do.

→→ More specifically, among the one-handed attacks it's the third attack of the light attack chain and the second hit of the running heavy attack, and among the two-handed/dual-wield attacks it's the first hit of the second attack in the light attack chain, the only hit of the fourth attack in the chain, and the second hit of the fifth attack in the chain, the first hit of the second heavy attack and the first and second hits of the second charged heavy attack, the third and fourth hits of the running heavy attack, the first hit of the backstep light attack and the guard counter, and all Critical Attacks.

Unlike the Backhand Blade, the Ash of War for the innate Skill: Blind Spot will be very far away from the point of acquisition for this weapon, making it impossible to pair with Affinities without the use of bugs for a long time.

weapons.name: Backhand Blade

skill.name: Blind Spot
skill.description: Leap into close quarters to take advantage of the enemy's blind spot and gore them from the side. Inputs determine which side you strike from. This attack slips below the opponent's guard.

weapons.description:
Curved blade wielded with a backhand grip. A type of weapon wielded by hornsent for generations.

Wielding this weapon resembles a deadly dance.

details: This weapon can be found beside a coffin in a gazebo in the Inquisitor section of Gravesite Plain, north-northeast of the Scorched Ruins Site of Grace.
→ On acquisition it has Ash of War: Blind Spot pre-equipped, despite already having Blind Spot as its underlying base skill — thus allowing this Ash of War to be obtained.

upgrade.material_info_source: deduced (wiki shows the weapon accepts Ashes of War/affinities; somber weapons cannot)

notes: While this isn't the only infusable Backhand Blade it was effectively the default one originally, as it doesn't have the unusual throwing attacks or Ashes of War restrictions of the Smithscript Cirque.
→ It does have the somewhat unusual quality of inflicting Pierce damage with some of its attacks, which most other Backhand Blades don't do.

→→ More specifically, among the one-handed attacks it's the third attack of the light attack chain and the second hit of the running heavy attack, and among the two-handed/dual-wield attacks it's the first hit of the second attack in the light attack chain, the only hit of the fourth attack in the chain, and the second hit of the fifth attack in the chain, the first hit of the second heavy attack and the first and second hits of the second charged heavy attack, the third and fourth hits of the running heavy attack, the first hit of the backstep light attack and the guard counter, and all Critical Attacks.
Extremely lightweight, almost on par with the Dagger, making it easy to keep as a backup weapon.

weapons.name: Smithscript Cirque

skill.name: Blind Spot
skill.description: Leap into close quarters to take advantage of the enemy's blind spot and gore them from the side. Inputs determine which side you strike from. This attack slips below the opponent's guard.

weapons.description:
Circular backhand blade engraved with a smithscript. A throwing weapon created through the smithing arts.

Execute a strong attack to throw the backhand blade, causing it to fly in a curved trajectory.

details: It can be looted from a body located by the edge of the sewage waterfall in the depths of the Forge.
→ More specifically, it's found a bit behind a lever-locked gate inside of the Forge.

estimate_if_undocumented.basis: 75 of 92 wiki-documented weapons with a non-unique skill use regular Smithing Stones

notes: As a Smithscript Weapon its heavy attacks involve throwing one or both of the Cirques.

→ The most notable downside of this is the greatly decreased Stance damage and damage potential of charged heavy attacks and guard counters. All thrown attacks also grant no points for the Winged Sword Insignias and the like.
Curiously, the thrown attacks do not suffer from damage fall-off though they do also have fairly short range.
This is the second lightest Smithscript Weapon, with only the Smithscript Dagger being lighter.
→ Like that weapon this one also doesn't suffer a damage penalty on the throwing portion of the throwing attacks compared to the melee portion of those same attacks.

patch_notes.official_notes: Decreased the damage of Backhand Blades against other players. (The Smithscript Cirque's throwing attacks are not affected by this change)
patch_notes.community_notes: Basically, the throwing attacks of the Smithscript Cirque don't suffer the -15% (occasionally -23%) damage penalty the non-throwing attacks have against other players.

patch_notes.official_notes: Extended the throwing attacks range for the following weapons: Smithscript Dagger / Smithscript Cirque
patch_notes.community_notes: This extended the range of throwing attacks to make them actually usable, as their range beforehand was barely greater than the reach of its non-throwing attacks.

patch_notes.official_notes: Fixed a bug that caused some affinities for the following weapons to be higher than intended: Smithscript Dagger / Smithscript Cirque / Smithscript Axe / Smithscript Greathammer / Smithscript Spear / Golem Fist / Smithscript Shield
patch_notes.community_notes: The bug was that non-Physical Affinities scaled their Physical damage with the same stat that their Elemental damage scaled with, granting abnormally high Attack Power.

weapons.name: Curseblade's Cirque
weapons.japanese_name: 呪剣士の円刃 (Jukenshi no Enjin)

skill.name: Deadly Dance
skill.description: An aggressive spinning skill that tears into foes using the circular blades held in each hand. Additional input allows for a sharp axe-kick follow-up.

weapons.description:
Weapon of the masked Curseblades. Circular backhand blade with wave-like cutting edges, sharpened into points that incite blood loss.

Long ago, this was employed by the ascetics who strove to become tutelary deities as a ritualistic object in their self-flagellating dances.

acquisition.location: Gravesite Plain / Belurat, Tower Settlement / Scadu Altus / Ancient Ruins of Rauh
details: 3% drop chance from Curseblades (2% drop chance from some of the Curseblades in Scaduview and Ancient Ruins of Rauh).
→ There is an easily reached Curseblade walking down the stairs leading down from the Stagefront Site of Grace in Belurat. By crouching it is possible to backstab it to make the fight easier.
→ The one directly northeast of the first Gravesite Plain is also easily reached, though it isn't really possible to ambush it.

upgrade.changeability_info_source: wiki (Ash of War-Compatible Armaments) + deduced (affinity_changeable: wiki rule, a weapon upgraded with Somber Smithing Stones takes no Ash of War, hence no affinity)

estimate_if_undocumented.basis: 57 of 58 wiki-documented weapons with a Unique Skill use Somber Smithing Stones

notes: This weapon has slightly better Guarded Damage Negation that other Backhand Blades, and significantly higher Guard Boost (45 compared to the other twos 15) making this weapon more suitable for doing Guard Counters without a shield.
Strongly Dexterity-leaning, though an equal Strength/Dexterity-split also gains decent results.
This weapon has a lower damage penalty against other players than other Backhand Blades, with attacks having a -10% or -19% penalty instead of the usual -15% or -23% penalties.
This is the heaviest Backhand Blade, weighing more than twice as much as the other two (though that still isn't very much).

weapons.name: Uchigatana

skill.name: Unsheathe
skill.description: Skill of swordsmen from the Land of Reeds. Sheathe blade, holding it at the hip in a composed stance. Follow up with a normal or strong attack to perform a swift slash attack.

weapons.description:
A katana with a long single-edged curved blade. A unique weapon wielded by the samurai from the Land of Reeds.

The blade, with its undulating design, boasts extraordinary sharpness, and its slash attacks cause blood loss.

details: 1 is part of the starting equipment for the Samurai Origin.
1 is found in the Deathtouched Catacombs on the hidden platform with a Skeleton Archer, just before the lever.
→ This spot is reached by going through an Illusory Wall on the right side of the stairs the first Skeleton enemy is standing on, then through a passage to the left.

upgrade.material_info_source: deduced (wiki shows the weapon accepts Ashes of War/affinities; somber weapons cannot)

notes: This is the easiest to attain and to wield infusable Katana.
→ It also makes dual-wielding it possible very early on for Samurais.

weapons.name: Nagakiba

skill.name: Unsheathe
skill.description: Skill of swordsmen from the Land of Reeds. Sheathe blade, holding it at the hip in a composed stance. Follow up with a normal or strong attack to perform a swift slash attack.

weapons.description:
Katana with a ferociously long blade. Signature weapon of Yura, hunter of Bloody Fingers.

Reminiscent of a reinforced spear, its imposing length can be put to good use with powerful thrusting attacks.

acquisition.location: Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Mountaintops of the Giants
details: The Nagakiba is either dropped by Bloody Finger Hunter Yura at the end of his questline at the Second Church of Marika or after being killed by the player. If the player visits the Three Fingers and inherits the Frenzied Flame, the Nagakiba will be found on the ground where Shabriri once stood near the Zamor Ruins, along with the Ronin's Set.
→ The Nagakiba comes pre-equipped with the Piercing Fang Ash of War and Standard affinity on it.

estimate_if_undocumented.basis: 75 of 92 wiki-documented weapons with a non-unique skill use regular Smithing Stones

notes: The Nagakiba has the longest range out of all the Katanas.

Unlike other Katanas the Nagakiba's heavy attacks and charged heavy attacks are all thrusting attacks, making it much more effective at inflicting Pierce damage than other Katanas (who are restricted to their first one-handed heavy attack, and one- or two-handed running heavy attacks).
The Nagakiba notably uses the fast version of Spinning Slash and Sword Dance. This, combined the Nagakiba's exceptional range, can create deadly combos and frame traps in PvP.

When using its Keen affinity it actually has slightly weaker Dexterity-scaling for "bullet"-type (i.e. doesn't scale directly with the used weapon's damage) Skills with a Keen, Quality, Lightning, or Cold affinity, giving them usually about 2% less damage than they otherwise would have. This includes, as an example, the skills Beast's Roar, Storm Blade, Thunderbolt, and Hoarfrost Stomp (these skills however perform as normal on any affinity besides Keen).

weapons.name: Serpentbone Blade

skill.name: Double Slash
skill.description: Skill of superior swordsmen. Perform a crossing slash attack from a low stance. Repeated inputs allow for up to two follow-up attacks.

weapons.description:
Sinister katana modeled after a serpent bone.

The densely packed row of spines that jut away from the cutting edge are coated in a lethal poison.

details: Obtained from Tanith, Volcano Manor Proprietress after defeating Rileigh the Idle.

→ This reward can still be received after defeating the Lord of Blasphemy as long as the second Letter from Volcano Manor was obtained beforehand. In this case the Serpentbone Blade should appear where Tanith normally sits after the assassination is done.

estimate_if_undocumented.basis: 75 of 92 wiki-documented weapons with a non-unique skill use regular Smithing Stones

notes: Has unique, double-hitting heavy attacks and charged heavy attacks. This gives about 50-100% extra points for the Winged Sword Insignias, at the cost of being slightly slower and dealing less damage per attack (especially for the first hit).

→ It's Skill: Double Slash is effectively almost identical, except with slightly more damage, significantly less stance damage, quicker execution, added FP consumption, and roughly equivalent Poison build-up.
→ These unique attacks are shared with the Sword of Night Shadow of the Erdtree.

Inflicts the Deadly version of Poison with its attacks, which deals damage equal to (0.14% of target's maximum HP + 14) per second for 30 seconds (total damage equal to 4.2% of target's maximum HP + 420).

→ While it can be somewhat difficult to inflict this Poison due to the relatively low build-up of the weapon, the short duration of this Poison makes it suitable for gaining the 20 second damage boosts from items such as Kindred of Rot's Exultation and Mushroom Crown.
Scales almost exclusively with Dexterity.

weapons.name: Meteoric Ore Blade

skill.name: Gravitas
skill.description: Skill originating from the Alabaster Lords, who had skin of stone. Thrust the armament into the ground to create a gravity well. In addition to dealing damage, this attack pulls enemies in.

weapons.description:
Katana forged from meteoric ore to dispatch lifeforms born of falling stars. Deals magic damage.

The blade is weighty known to deliver slashes of such ferocity that the impact is said to resemble the crash of a falling meteor.

details: Found in the underground chambers in the northwest section of the Caelid Waypoint Ruins. It is inside of a chest behind a door in the far corner of the room.

notes: The Meteoric Ore Blade cannot be buffed by spells or consumables.
The Meteoric Ore Blade cannot have its Skill or Affinity changed.
The Meteoric Ore Blade has Gravitas as its innate skill.
→ This weapon is technically the strongest possible weapon for this skill, though the somewhat mediocre Intelligence scaling for the weapon itself makes this hard to take advantage of.
The Meteoric Ore Blade deals +20% extra damage bonus against Gravity-affinity enemies.

The Strength-scaling is slightly stronger than the Intelligence-scaling and works off the greater Physical base damage. However, the Intelligence-scaling increases the damage of Gravitas and a Strength/Intelligence hybrid build deals damage that is almost equivalent to a pure Strength one.
The Meteoric Ore Blade has a unique heavy attack and charged heavy attack that consist of a straight-down slash.
→ Despite how it may look, this attack deals the same amount of Stance damage as the normal Katana heavy attacks.
→ Compared to a regular katana heavy attack or charged heavy attack, this is the tiniest bit quicker in exchange for dealing about 2% less damage.

weapons.name: Moonveil

skill.name: Transient Moonlight
skill.description: Sheathe blade, holding it at the hip in a composed stance. Follow up with either a normal or a strong attack to draw the blade at great speed for an instant slash attack. Both attacks fire off a wave of light.

weapons.description:
Katana forged of glintstone. Masterpiece of a Sellian swordsmith.

Light enwreathes the blade when sheathed, explaining its Moonveil moniker.

details: Dropped by the Magma Wyrm in Gael Tunnel.

upgrade.changeability_info_source: wiki (Ash of War-Compatible Armaments) + deduced (affinity_changeable: wiki rule, a weapon upgraded with Somber Smithing Stones takes no Ash of War, hence no affinity)

estimate_if_undocumented.basis: 57 of 58 wiki-documented weapons with a Unique Skill use Somber Smithing Stones

notes: The Unique Skill: Transient Moonlight is the regular Skill: Unsheathe but with added projectiles: a short-ranged one for the light attack sweep and a mid-ranged one for the heavy attack overhead slash.

→ The skill is useful in roughly the same ways that Unsheathe is, meaning that the light attack follow-up is generally slightly quicker and much wider in exchange for being slightly weaker, while the heavy attack follow-up hits a single target slightly harder and is slightly more difficult to roll directly away from.

→→ One stark difference is that the different attacks are much less dissimilar, with the light attack follow-up having less of a damage difference (22% less for Unsheathe, 10% less for Transient Moonlight) and much less of a Stance damage difference (50% less for Unsheathe, 8% less for Transient Moonlight).

→ While this does give the weapon some more reach (though mostly with the heavy attack follow-up), the skill is still the most effective at melee range since that means both the weapon and the magic waves can hit the target.
→ The skill's heavy attack follow-up has a weird interaction with jumping players and deals a lot less damage against them for some reason.

While a hybrid Intelligence/Dexterity build gains the highest total Attack Power a pure Intelligence build only loses about 2% total Attack Power in exchange for the skill's projectiles getting 13% higher Attack Power, making the latter generally preferable.

weapons.name: Sword of Night

skill.name: Witching Hour Slash
skill.description: Hold the sword level and infuse it with the dark of Night before unleashing a series of incorporeal attacks. This attack cannot be blocked. Can be charged to increase its power.

weapons.description: Sword of an all-consuming, bottomless black that devours even the light that shines upon it. Wielded by Jolán, Swordhand of Night. The blade of the sword is only semicorporeal, and thus cannot be guarded against completely.

details: Defeat Metyr, Mother of Fingers by following Count Ymir's questline and then defeat both him and Jolán, Swordhand of Night. Reload the area, and the player will find Jolán sitting on the ground against the pillar when she usually stands. Give her the Iris of Occultation, and she'll die and drop the Sword of Night.

notes: The Sword of Night cannot be buffed by spells or any consumables.
The Sword of Night cannot have its Skill or Affinity changed.

The Unique Skill: Witching Hour Slash is a chargeable attack that unleashes a series of three unblockable sword slashes. The fully charged version surrounds the user with slashes as well as increasing the damage.
→ The charged or uncharged version of the skill forms a true combo when followed by a regular heavy attack if it staggers the target, letting it deal heavy damage.
All attacks from the Sword of Night (including the skill) bypass 50% of Guarded Damage Negation, making this weapon able to largely ignore an opponent's block.

The Sword of Night has the same double-hitting heavy attacks and charged heavy attacks as the Serpentbone Blade, which hit twice, letting one deal heavy Stance damage while building up the bonus damage from the Winged Sword Insignias.

While the Sword of Night only scales with Dexterity, both the Physical and Magic Attack Power increase when leveling up that attribute making this weapon highly effective with pure Dexterity builds but only somewhat usable for hybrid builds that include Dexterity.

weapons.name: Rivers of Blood

skill.name: Corpse Piler
skill.description: Forms a blade of cursed blood for repeated, interweaving successive attacks. Follow up with an additional input for further successive attacks.

weapons.description:
Weapon of Okina, swordsman from the Land of Reeds. A cursed weapon that has felled countless men.

When Mohg, the Lord of Blood, first felt Okina's sword, and madness, upon his flesh, he had a proposal, to offer Okina the life of a demon, whose thirst would never go unsated.

details: Defeat Okina at the Church of Repose.

notes: Rivers of Blood cannot be buffed by spells or any consumables.
Rivers of Blood cannot have its Skill or Affinity changed.
The Unique Skill: Corpse Piler, is a unique, stronger version of Double Slash that has longer range and extra Bleed build-up.

Although the Arcane-scaling is lower than the Dexterity-scaling, it is generally more advantageous to level up the former when using Rivers of Blood. Dexterity will only increase the Physical Attack Power, while Arcane will increase both the Physical and Fire Attack Power simultaneously, on top of increasing the Blood Loss build-up of the weapon.

→ More specifically, though the Arcane-scaling is theoretically 35% weaker than the Dexterity-scaling the fact that the former applies to both (equally large) Attack Powers makes it practically 30% stronger than the latter.
→ The Blood Loss build-up of a +10 Rivers of Blood will be 62 at 20 Arcane, 72 at 45 Arcane, and 79 at 80 Arcane.

weapons.name: Dragonscale Blade

skill.name: Ice Lightning Sword
skill.description: Call down a bolt of ice lightning into the blade and bring it down upon a foe. The ice lightning effect will persist for a while.

passive_effects: Deals increased damage to Dragons and Ancient Dragons
weapons.description:
A weapon made by sharpening a Gravel Stone scale, thought to be the source of ancient dragon immortality, into an unclouded blade.

Alas, the Dragonkin Soldiers never attained immortality, and perished as decrepit, pale imitations of their skyborn kin.

details: Dropped by the Dragonkin Soldier boss in the Lake of Rot.
→ A platform can be raised by buttons in the immediate area, making it slightly easier to fight the boss without constantly being afflicted with Scarlet Rot.

upgrade.changeability_info_source: wiki (Ash of War-Compatible Armaments) + deduced (affinity_changeable: wiki rule, a weapon upgraded with Somber Smithing Stones takes no Ash of War, hence no affinity)

estimate_if_undocumented.basis: 57 of 58 wiki-documented weapons with a Unique Skill use Somber Smithing Stones

notes: The Unique Skill: Ice Lightning Sword is essentially a stronger variant of the Skill: Lightning Slash with a twice as strong Weapon Buff that also adds 80 Frostbite build-up to the weapon.
Deals 20% more damage against Dragon-type enemies and 10% more damage against Ancient Dragon-type enemies.
→ The weapon does unfortunately only have the general dragon weakness, Pierce damage, on its one-handed heavy attacks, but the primary case against this weapon is its very late acquisition.
This is the only Katana without an innate Status Effect, requiring its skill to get access to that.

Despite the letter difference in its Strength- and Dexterity-scaling grades a Strength/Dexterity build gains almost much Attack Power as a pure Dexterity build when one-handed, and is equal when two-handed.

weapons.name: Star-Lined Sword

skill.name: Onze's Line of Stars
skill.description: This skill, named after a demi-human swordmaster, imbues sorcerous energy into lined glintstones and executes a slash attack. Repeated inputs allow for up to two follow-up attacks, each dealing greater damage than the last.

weapons.description:
Sword encrusted with a line of stars fashioned from small pieces of crude glintstone. Weapon of the demi-human swordsmen.

When bestowed with this weapon by their queen, the swordsmen swear to find the truth that lies at the end of the procession of stars.

details: Dropped by Demi-Human Queen Marigga.

upgrade.changeability_info_source: wiki (Ash of War-Compatible Armaments) + deduced (affinity_changeable: wiki rule, a weapon upgraded with Somber Smithing Stones takes no Ash of War, hence no affinity)

estimate_if_undocumented.basis: 57 of 58 wiki-documented weapons with a Unique Skill use Somber Smithing Stones

notes: The Unique Skill: Onze's Line of Stars is a double slash with the katana, creating a blue line of stars with each slash. Inputting the skill button again extends the combo up to two times, starting with a delayed double slash and then finishing with a teleporting overhead double slash.
→ This skill is primarily useful against regular enemies since it can potentially keep them stunlocked throughout the combo whereas it lacks the speed and Hyper or Super Armor to handle bosses.

→ Despite its appearance the second follow-up input does not grant Invincibility Frames, though it will still keep them safe from some low-moving attacks (it's not a jump so it won't ignore many groundbound shockwave attacks such as Furnace Golem jumps).
The Star-Lined Sword does not inflict Frostbite, despite how Demi-Human Swordmaster Onze is occasionally able to inflict it with the weapon.

Compared to Moonveil, the Star-Lined Sword is better suited for Dexterity builds with some investment into Intelligence; the Intelligence scaling and Magic Attack Power is quite pitiful for its moderate Intelligence requirement. For this weapon it's better to reach the 21 Intelligence required for it and then pump the rest of the points into Dexterity.

weapons.name: Hand of Malenia
weapons.japanese_name: マレニアの義手刀 (Marenia no Gishutō)

skill.name: Waterfowl Dance
skill.description: Perform a series of one-footed leaps in the manner of a waterfowl to unleash a swift yet graceful slashing combo. Repeated inputs allow for up to two follow-up attacks.

weapons.description:
Blade built into Malenia's prosthetic arm. Through consecration it is resistant to rot.

Malenia's war prosthesis symbolized her victories.

Some claim to have seen wings when the weapon was raised aloft; wings of fierce determination that have never known defeat.

details: Trade the Remembrance of the Rot Goddess, gained by defeating Malenia, Blade of Miquella, with Finger Reader Enia.
→ Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

notes: Hand of Malenia cannot be buffed by spells or any consumables.
Hand of Malenia cannot have its Skill or Affinity changed.

The Unique Skill: Waterfowl Dance allows the user to leap up into the air and unleash a barrage of sword-slashing strikes. This skill has two additional follow-up attacks if the user keeps inputting the skill button, though windows for these inputs are very short.
→ The skill also counts as a jump for certain section of it, letting the user potentially avoid ground-bound or low-hitting attacks.

→ Because the user doesn't fall down when attacking with this skill, even when above a drop, it is possible to travel greater vertical distances than normal with it while only experiencing small drops until the end. Thanks to a glitch it is also possible to prevent losing height until all follow-ups are used/the skill ends, though that is more complicated.

The Hand of Malenia is the second longest Katana in the game after the Nagakiba, while also having the best overall Attack Power. However, this comes at the cost of having the highest Dexterity requirement.

→ While some Katanas may have a greater total Attack Power than the Hand of Malenia, this is largely due in part to them having split damage, and weapons with innate split damage typically deal less damage overall than weapons that deal purely Physical or Elemental damage due to how defenses are calculated.

weapons.name: Reed Great Katana

skill.name: Overhead Stance
skill.description: A skill that starts with the blade held high in a ready stance. Execute a normal attack from this stance to step forward and slash downwards, or a strong attack to deliver a series of downward slashes.

weapons.description:
Large katana with a long, heavy blade. A weapon unique to warriors of the Land of Reeds.

Designed for aggression, this armament requires the wielder to throw their entire body into swinging it. The slashing attacks of its honed edge incite blood loss.

details: Found on a corpse close to the Fort Faroth site of grace, sitting on top of a large malformed skull next to where Greyoll lies.

estimate_if_undocumented.basis: 75 of 92 wiki-documented weapons with a non-unique skill use regular Smithing Stones

notes: When compared to the Great Katana, the Reed Great Katana has higher base damage and lower stat requirements, but has worse scaling, shorter range, and weighs a tad more. The real advantage of the Reed Great Katana is being able to obtain a Great Katana without having to traverse to the Realm of Shadow.

The Reed Great Katana actually outdamages the normal Great Katana on Cold, Sacred, Magic and Flame Art affinities thanks to its higher base damage, making it viable for spellblades or pure Faith builds.

Unlike the Great Katana, the Ash of War for the innate Skill: Overhead Stance will be very far away from the point of acquisition for this weapon, making it impossible to pair with Affinities without the use of bugs for a long time.

weapons.name: Great Katana

skill.name: Overhead Stance
skill.description: A skill that starts with the blade held high in a ready stance. Execute a normal attack from this stance to step forward and slash downwards, or a strong attack to deliver a series of downward slashes.

weapons.description:
Large katana with a prominent tempering pattern on its black blade, unique to warriors of the Land of Reeds. The most finely honed of its ilk.

Designed for aggression, this armament requires the wielder to throw their entire body into swinging it. The slashing attacks of its honed edge incite blood loss.

details: Found on a corpse in the lake on the northern Gravesite Plain, west of Abandoned Ailing Village, where the Ghostflame Dragon is fought.
→ Comes equipped with the Ash of War: Overhead Stance by default.

estimate_if_undocumented.basis: 75 of 92 wiki-documented weapons with a non-unique skill use regular Smithing Stones

notes: Like the other Great Katanas, this weapon leans towards Dexterity over Strength, if not by much.

weapons.name: Dragon Hunter's Great Katana
weapons.japanese_name: 竜狩りの大刀 (Ryūgari no Tachi)

skill.name: Dragonwound Slash
skill.description: Designed to hunt colossal dragons, this skill cloaks the armament with a jagged gravel-stone aura before performing a high leaping slash. Charge the attack to also fire off the aura.

passive_effects: Deals increased damage to Dragons and Ancient Dragons
weapons.description:
Great katana with spines of gravel stone along its blade, wielded by the Ancient Dragon-Man of the Dragon's Pit. Has an anti-dragon effect.

Formerly a Dragon Communion warrior, the Ancient Dragon-Man was once arbiter of those worthy to devour the Dreaded One.

details: The Dragon-Hunter's Great Katana is received upon defeating the Ancient Dragon-Man at the end of the Dragon's Pit dungeon.

upgrade.changeability_info_source: wiki (Ash of War-Compatible Armaments) + deduced (affinity_changeable: wiki rule, a weapon upgraded with Somber Smithing Stones takes no Ash of War, hence no affinity)

estimate_if_undocumented.basis: 57 of 58 wiki-documented weapons with a Unique Skill use Somber Smithing Stones

notes: The Unique Skill: Dragonwound Slash causes the wielder to jump into the air and slash the Dragon-Hunter's Great Katana, which deals +20% extra damage against Dragons and Ancient Dragons. Fully charging the skill causes the Dragon-Hunter's Great Katana to fire a projectile at the same time as the slash.
The Dragon-Hunter's Great Katana deals +30% extra damage against Dragons and +15% against Ancient Dragons.

→ Ironically, despite this special damage bonus, it is somewhat counter-intuitive as most Dragons in the game are resistant to Slash, the main damage type of the Dragon-Hunter's Great Katana, with very few attacks of it dealing Pierce which Dragons are weak against. This means that the bonus mostly just serves to partially compensate for the sub-optimal damage type.
The Dragon-Hunter's Great Katana is the shortest out of all the Great Katanas.
On a Quality build, the Dragon-Hunter's Great Katana is the second strongest Great Katana, usually lagging behind Rakshasa's Great Katana by around ~20 AR on average.
→ It isn't as strong on a pure Dexterity or pure Strength build, but it isn't that far behind, usually by about 5%.

weapons.name: Rakshasa's Great Katana

skill.name: Weed Cutter
skill.description: Performs scythe-like horizontal swings with the sword, cutting men down as if they were weeds. Additional inputs allow for the continuation of the attack for as long as stamina remains.

weapons.description:
A great katana with the tempering pattern of its blade forever stained red with blood. Weapon of Rakshasa, who cuts down and devours.

A berserker's weapon used to endure enemy attacks and reply with one's full fury. When attacking, the wielder is less likely to stagger from counterattacks, but will also take increased damage.

details: Gained by defeating Rakshasa in the Eastern Nameless Mausoleum.

notes: Rakshasa's Great Katana cannot be buffed by spells or any consumables.
Rakshasa's Great Katana cannot have its Skill or Affinity changed.
Weed Cutter causes the user swing Rakshasa's Great Katana in long, sweeping horizontal strikes. This move can be used as long as the user has enough Stamina.
When attacking the wielder gains Poise, but also suffers a -10% reduction in all Damage Negations.
→ Light attacks will grant 77 Poise (7.7 in PvE).
→ Charged heavy attacks will grant 154 Poise (15.4 in PvE).
→ Guard Counter attacks will grant 38.5 Poise (3.85 in PvE).
→ All other attacks will grant 57.75 Poise (5.775 in PvE).
Rakshasa's Great Katana has a unique thrusting heavy attack, charged heavy attack, and feint attack that deals Pierce damage, whether one- or two-handed.
→ It should be noted that the feint attack (performed by dodging when charging a heavy attack) has the same slash-like animation as the other Great Katanas' feint attack in spite of this.
Rakshasa's Great Katana is the longest Great Katana.
In terms of raw damage, Rakshasa's Great Katana has the highest base Attack Power out of all the Great Katanas.

→ Though its scalings are weighted towards Dexterity, a hybrid Strength/Dexterity build gains respectable Attack Power: less than with a pure Dexterity build but more than any other Great Katana with a hybrid Strength/Dexterity build.

weapons.name: Twinblade

skill.name: Spinning Slash
skill.description: Skill favored by dexterous warriors. Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.

weapons.description:
A sword with blades on both sides of the hilt. This weapon is difficult to wield and demands high dexterity.

Can be wielded with a single hand, but its true strength is unlocked with dual-handed spinning attacks.

details: Found in a chest in the southeastern basement room of the Ruins, the one without the Rats, that is reached by using Torrent to jump over a crumbled wall into an enclosure.

upgrade.material_info_source: deduced (wiki shows the weapon accepts Ashes of War/affinities; somber weapons cannot)

notes: This is the most basic Twinblade, with relatively low weight and wielding requirements, and early acquisition. It does, however, also have consistently the lowest damage of all infusable Twinblades.

weapons.name: Twinned Knight Swords

skill.name: Spinning Slash
skill.description: Skill favored by dexterous warriors. Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.

weapons.description:
An attractive twinblade of fine make that prizes the chivalric way.

Can be wielded with a single hand, but its true strength is unlocked with dual-handed spinning attacks.

details: Found on a corpse just northwest of the East Windmill Pasture.

estimate_if_undocumented.basis: 75 of 92 wiki-documented weapons with a non-unique skill use regular Smithing Stones

notes: A generally Strength-aspected weapon, though it performs rather mediocrely with elemental infusions.
→ Though it is outclassed by the Gargoyle's Twinblade in terms of Attack Power, it is slightly longer which can help sometimes.

weapons.name: Black Steel Twinblade
weapons.japanese_name: 黒鉄の両刃剣 (Kurogane no Ryōbaken)

skill.name: Spinning Slash
skill.description: Skill favored by dexterous warriors. Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.

weapons.description:
Weapon of the Black Knights, servants of Messmer the Impaler. Twinblade of black steel with decorative embellishments in gold.

Blessed with an Erdtree incantation. Further holy imbuement will amplify the effect and greatly increase the armament's power.

details: Guaranteed drop from the Black Knight at the top of the western hill camp off to the side of the encampment in front of the Shadow Keep, or northeast of Church of the Crusade.

upgrade.material_info_source: deduced (wiki shows the weapon accepts Ashes of War/affinities; somber weapons cannot)

notes: The Black Steel Twinblade is the longest Twinblade in the game.

The Black Steel Twinblade has unique one- and two-handed standing, charged, and running heavy attacks where the user stabs with the sharp end of the Twinblade (only the second hit for the running heavy attacks). These attack are also used with the Godskin Peeler.
→ Additionally, all the two-handed light attacks deal Pierce damage with their final hit.

The Black Steel Twinblade has innate Holy Attack Power, which can be increased by infusing it with the Sacred Affinity, using Sacred Blade, or Weapon Buffs like the Golden Grease Shadow of the Erdtree.

On a pure Faith build, compared to Euporia Shadow of the Erdtree in terms of damage, Euporia will ultimately win out in the end on a consistent basis due to its more slightly more favorable scaling values on top of its unique "Luster" mechanic, which further increases its damage. The main advantage of the Black Steel Twinblade is the fact that it can be buffed and infused with different Ashes of War.

→ When infused with Flame Art, the Black Steel Twinblade will have a considerably higher Attack Power, but this is largely due the weapon gaining three different damage types. Do note that on a Flame Art infusion, the Holy Attack Power will be reduced significantly.

weapons.name: Godskin Peeler

skill.name: Black Flame Tornado
skill.description: Spin armament overhead and then plunge it into the ground to summon a raging vortex of black flames. Hold to create an initial flame tornado while spinning the armament.
skill.attack_type: Fire, Blackflame, & Weapon's Primary Damage Type

weapons.description:
Unique twinblade wielded by Godskin Apostles characterized by its disturbing design. One end features a sickle for slicing attacks while the other boasts a winding spike for boring into flesh.

Much skill is required to wield this weapon due to its asymmetric nature.

details: Dropped by the Godskin Apostle at the end of Dominula, Windmill Village.

upgrade.material_info_source: deduced (wiki shows the weapon accepts Ashes of War/affinities; somber weapons cannot)

notes: The Godskin Peeler comes equipped with Black Flame Tornado as its default Skill, long before the Ash of War for that skill becomes available.

→ If the player wants to keep Black Flame Tornado, it's best to infuse the Godskin Peeler with the Flame Art Affinity and invest in Faith, as Black Flame Tornado scales with both weapon level and Faith.

The Godskin Peeler has unique one- and two-handed standing, charged, and running heavy attacks where the user stabs with the sharp end of the Twinblade (only the second hit for the running heavy attacks). These attack are also used with the Black Steel Twinblade Shadow of the Erdtree.
→ Additionally, all the two-handed light attacks deal Pierce damage with their final hit.
Like most Twinblades, the Godskin Peeler performs exceptionally well on status-inflicting builds, especially with Blood or Cold.
Despite its hooked appearance this weapon has no innate guard-piercing.
Heavily Dexterity-leaning, though it performs pretty well on non-Dexterity affinities as well.

→ When using its Keen affinity it actually has slightly weaker Dexterity-scaling for "bullet"-type (i.e. doesn't scale directly with the used weapon's damage) Skills with a Keen, Quality, Lightning, or Cold affinity, giving them usually about 2% less damage than they otherwise would have. This includes, as an example, the skills Beast's Roar, Storm Blade, Thunderbolt, and Hoarfrost Stomp (these skills however perform as normal on any affinity besides Keen).

weapons.name: Gargoyle's Twinblade
weapons.japanese_name: ガーゴイルの両刃剣 (Gāgoiru no Ryōbaken)

skill.name: Spinning Slash
skill.description: Skill favored by dexterous warriors. Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.

weapons.description:
Bronze twinblade wielded by Valiant Gargoyles.

Just like the wielder, the missing parts have been mended with corpse wax; a patchwork of champions.

details: Dropped by the Valiant Gargoyle duo boss, along with the Gargoyle's Greatsword.

upgrade.material_info_source: deduced (wiki shows the weapon accepts Ashes of War/affinities; somber weapons cannot)

notes: The Gargoyle's Twinblade has the highest base Attack Power and has an A-scaling in Strength on a Heavy infusion, making it the best Twinblade for raw power and Strength builds, and it also has respectable status build-up when infused with Blood or Poison with some investment into Arcane.

→ When using its Heavy affinity it actually has slightly weaker Strength-scaling for "bullet"-type (i.e. doesn't scale directly with the used weapon's damage) Skills with a Heavy, Quality, or Fire Affinity, giving them usually about 2% less damage than they otherwise would have. This includes, as an example, the skills Ground Slam, Storm Blade, and Flame of the Redmanes (these skills however perform as normal on any affinity besides Heavy).
The Gargoyle's Twinblade and the Gargoyle's Black Blades are the shortest Twinblades in the game.

weapons.name: Gargoyle's Black Blades
weapons.japanese_name: ガーゴイルの黒両刃 (Gāgoiru no Kuroryōba)

skill.name: Spinning Slash
skill.description: Skill favored by dexterous warriors. Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.

weapons.description:
Bronze twinblade wielded by Valiant Gargoyles, mended with blackened corpse wax. Deals holy damage.

Such is the mark of those who serve Maliketh, the Black Blade.

details: Received upon defeating Black Blade Kindred before the Grand Lift of Rold, along with the Gargoyle's Black Axe.

upgrade.changeability_info_source: wiki (Ash of War-Compatible Armaments) + deduced (affinity_changeable: wiki rule, a weapon upgraded with Somber Smithing Stones takes no Ash of War, hence no affinity)

estimate_if_undocumented.basis: 75 of 92 wiki-documented weapons with a non-unique skill use regular Smithing Stones

notes: Generally outclassed by infusable Twinblades since it's essentially a Gargoyle's Twinblade with an always active Holy Weapon Buff, weaker Physical Attack Power, and a locked, mediocre skill, especially since it lacks the Gargoyle's Blackblade's Corpse Wax-enhacement on the skill.
→ Focusing on its fairly good Strength-scaling grants the most Attack Power for this weapon, while Dexterity and Faith grants minimal returns.
Though the description may imply otherwise this weapon's version of the Skill: Spinning Slash is the same as the one found on its Ash of War, with no Power of Corpse Wax-enhancement.
→ Since Spinning Slash isn't very good on Twinblades it is best to focus on the weapon's regular attacks.

weapons.name: Eleonora's Poleblade
weapons.japanese_name: エレオノーラの双薙刀 (Ereonōra no Sōnaginata)

skill.name: Bloodblade Dance
skill.description: Leap at foe to perform a flurry of tornado-like attacks. Follow up with an additional input to perform an attack that ends in an evasive maneuver.

weapons.description:
Twinned naginata forged in the Land of Reeds. Chosen weapon of Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger.

Her mastery of the sword was such that her onslaught was likened to a whirlwind, but now her legacy is stained by accursed blood.

details: Dropped by the invader Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger at the Second Church of Marika.
→ Eleonora spawns at the Church regardless if the Tarnished is doing Yura's questline or not.

notes: Eleonora's Poleblade cannot be buffed by spells or any consumables.
Eleonora's Poleblade cannot have its Skill or its Affinity changed.

Eleonora's Poleblade has a unique heavy attack not shared by any other Twinblade, which is a diagonal spinning slash that hits multiple times. The charged version of the heavy attack will cause the player to spin more times.

→ For one-handed attacks the first heavy attacks hits two times instead of one time and the charged heavy attacks hits four times for the first one and three times for the second one, both instead of one hit. For the two-handed attacks the second heavy attack hits one time instead of two times and the charged heavy attacks hit five times for the first one and three times for the seconds one, both instead of four hits.

Although the Arcane scaling is 25% lower than the Dexterity scaling, it is slightly advantageous to level up the former when using Eleonora's Poleblade because Dexterity will only increase the Physical Attack Power, while Arcane will increase both the Physical and Fire Attack Power simultaneously as well as also increasing the Blood Loss build-up of the weapon.
→ The Blood Loss build-up of a +10 Eleonora's Poleblade will be 67 at 20 Arcane, 77 at 45 Arcane, and 84 at 80 Arcane.

weapons.name: Euporia

skill.name: Euporia Vortex
skill.description: Using the power of the vortex, violently twirl the armament, dealing multiple slashes directly ahead. The greater the restored luster of the blades, the greater the power of this skill. However, use of this skill will fully consume the blades' luster.

passive_effects: Gains Luster upon damaging an enemy, which increases the potency of its Skill
weapons.description:
Twinblade symbolizing abundance. The secret treasure of the tower.

Though the blades, fashioned from golden shoots, are largely wilted and darkened, their luster can be restored by dealing damage to foes. However, damage dealt to Those Who Live in Death will have no such effect.

details: This armament is technically found in Belurat, Tower Settlement, however, reaching it can only be done through Enir-Ilim. On the stairs past the lightning-aspected Divine Beast Warrior, jump off the path onto a lower staircase and then follow the ledges down until you reach a platform with a Fireproof Pickled Liver. Jump into the nearby window (sprinting is advised), and then go out to the balcony and follow the path to the right down the lifts, past the Inquisitors and the Divine Beast Warrior. Euporia lies at the end of this path.

notes: Euporia cannot be buffed by spells or any consumables.
Euporia cannot have its Skill or Affinity changed.

Euporia has a unique "Luster" mechanic wherein every hit with the Euporia adds "points" to its Luster, which split into two tiers: 25 points and 50. When enough points are gained, the Euporia will glow golden and receive a +95 Holy Attack Power buff at tier 1, and a +120 Holy Attack Power buff at tier 2. Luster also increases the power of the Unique Skill: Euporia Vortex.

→ Euporia Vortex will fire of a powerful holy laser beam from the center of the twinblade while it twirls. Depending on the current tier of Luster, the power and duration of Euporia Vortex is increased.
→ Luster has a decay mechanic in which the weapon will lose one point of Luster every second (every 0.7 seconds at tier 2) if it's not hitting an opponent.
→ The wielder will not gain any Luster points on enemies that are undead.
→ Luster also accumulates when dual-wielding another Twinblade, even if the Euporia is in the off-hand.

→→ Dual-wielding two Euporia will cause them to accumulate the same amount of Luster, meaning the wielder can have two buffed Euporia at the same time. However, using Euporia Vortex will cause both Euporia to lose their Luster at the same time.

patch_notes.official_notes: Fixed a bug where Euporia could increase the attack power of other weapons when its luster is restored. Fixed a bug where the restored luster effect of Euporia was sometimes displayed on different weapons.
patch_notes.community_notes: Two-handing a left-handed weapon while Euporia was equipped in the right hand and had its luster restored would grant that other weapon the glow and added Holy Attack Power that Euporia would normally receive.

patch_notes.official_notes: Increased Holy damage when the weapon has its luster restored. Decreased the number of attacks required to restore the weapon’s luster. Increased the duration of the luster restoration effect.
patch_notes.community_notes: The added Holy Attack Power was increased from +35 to +95 for tier 1 and from +80 to +120 for tier 2. Despite the description, the two tiers' required accumuVal doesn't appear to have been changed. Increased the duration of both tiers from 15 seconds to 30 seconds.

weapons.name: Hand Axe

skill.name: Quickstep
skill.description:
Skill prized by the crafty and fleet of foot.
Perform a quickstep maneuver that allows for circling around lock-on targets.

weapons.description:
Commonly known as a hatchet, this smaller variety of axe is an everyday work tool.

Despite its short reach, it is easy to handle, exceling in successive attacks.

details: 1 is sold for 600 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant located in eastern Limgrave in the Mistwood, south of the Minor Erdtree there.

upgrade.material_info_source: deduced (wiki shows the weapon accepts Ashes of War/affinities; somber weapons cannot)

notes: Though the Hand Axe generally has the lowest or second lowest Attack Power among the infusable Axes it also has by far the lowest wielding requirement of them, needing an investment in neither Strength nor Dexterity to wield and therefore making it useful for builds with little investment in either (or simply little to no Strength).
→ It is also fairly light, being the third lightest Axe.
Has unique one- and two-handed light attack chains, both of which are overall half a second quicker than the regular Axe moveset's versions.
→ Shared with the Forked Hatchet, Icerind Hatchet, and Forked-Tongue Hatchet Shadow of the Erdtree.
This weapon is in the second shortest grouping of Axes, outreaching only 4 slightly shorter Axes.

weapons.name: Forked Hatchet

skill.name: Quickstep
skill.description:
Skill prized by the crafty and fleet of foot.
Perform a quickstep maneuver that allows for circling around lock-on targets.

weapons.description:
Peculiar hatched wielded by imps.

The gently undulating forked blade is known as an "imp's tongue" and causes blood loss.

acquisition.location: Fringefolk Hero's Grave & Stormfoot Catacombs & Murkwater Catacombs / Impaler's Catacombs (Weeping Peninsula) / Road's End Catacombs & Cliffbottom Catacombs (Liurnia of the Lakes) / Wyndham Catacombs & Sainted Hero's Grave (Altus Plateau) / Minor Erdtree Catacombs & War-Dead Catacombs (Caelid) / Auriza Side Tomb & Leyndell, Royal Capital & Subterranean Shunning-Grounds (Capital Outskirts) / Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs & Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave (Mountaintops of the Giants) / Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs (Consecrated Snowfield)
details: 2% drop chance from hatchet-wielding Fanged Imps.
→ Stormfoot Catacombs is an easy farming spot, being located very early in the game and having a small sideroom with two hatchet-wielding Imps just after the Site of Grace at the entrance.
→ Murkwater Catacombs also has two hatchet-wielding Imps in the corridor just after the entrance.

upgrade.material_info_source: deduced (wiki shows the weapon accepts Ashes of War/affinities; somber weapons cannot)

notes: Though the Forked Hatchet generally has the lowest or second lowest Attack Power among the infusable Axes it also has a very low Strength Requirement and is the only infusable Axe with an innate Status Effect, Blood Loss in this case.
→ It is also very light, being the lightest of all Axes.
Has unique one- and two-handed light attack chains, both of which are overall half a second quicker than the regular Axe moveset's versions.
→ Shared with the Hand Axe, Icerind Hatchet, and Forked-Tongue Hatchet Shadow of the Erdtree.
Except for the one- and two-handed light attack chains, all of this weapon's attacks actually deal Pierce damage instead of the listed Standard damage.
→ This trait is shared with the Forked-Tongue Hatchet Shadow of the Erdtree.
Generally Dexterity-leaning on its affinities and performs best on a Keen affinity but also works quite well with the Occult affinity due to having an innate Status Effect.

→ Despite this its Keen affinity actually gives it slightly weaker Dexterity-scaling for "bullet"-type (i.e. doesn't scale directly with the used weapon's damage) Skills with a Keen, Quality, Lightning, or Cold affinity, giving them usually about 2% less damage than they otherwise would have. This includes, as an example, the skills Beast's Roar, Thunderbolt, and Hoarfrost Stomp (these skills however perform as normal on any affinity besides Keen).
This is the shortest of all Axes.

patch_notes.official_notes: Increased damage.
patch_notes.community_notes: Increased the base Attack Power of all Affinities by roughly 7%.

weapons.name: Forked-Tongue Hatchet
weapons.japanese_name: 二又舌の手斧 (Futamata Shita no Teono)

skill.name: Dragonform Flame
skill.description: Spew fire from a dragon-form maw, sweeping in a frontward arc. The flames on the ground will continue to burn for a short time.

weapons.description:
