A peculiar weapon wielded by imps. Hatchet smithed in the shape of a fork-tongued dragon.

The gently undulating forked blade is known as an "imp's tongue" and causes blood loss.

acquisition.location: Fog Rift Catacombs / Darklight Catacombs (Scadu Altus) / Scorpion River Catacombs (Rauh Base)
details: 2% drop chance from hatchet-wielding Fanged Imps in the Realm of Shadow.

→ The earliest farming spot is in Darklight Catacombs by using the Stake of Marika found just after the first elevator down in the dungeon, where one hatchet-wielding Imp can be found down a set of stairs and a greatsword-wielder can be found next to the Stake to kill the Tarnished and trigger a respawn at it.

→ One easily farmed Imp can be found in the Scorpion River Catacombs by taking two left turned after the grace, in a dead-end room (two other, non-hatchet Imps can be found on the way but only the second one will have to be dealt with).
→→ There is also another hatchet-wielding Imp found across the bridge in the room beside the dead-end room, that can be pulled over with a Kukri or a Crossbow/Bow to kill.

notes: The Unique Skill: Dragonform Flame is a slow, sweeping, short-ranged Fire attack with minimal use cases.
→ This is effectively the same as the Steel-Wire Torch's Skill: Firebreather.
Has unique one- and two-handed light attack chains, both of which are overall half a second quicker than the regular Axe moveset's versions.
→ Shared with the Forked Hatchet, Hand Axe, and Icerind Hatchet.
Except for the one- and two-handed light attack chains, all of this weapon's attacks actually deal Pierce damage instead of the listed Standard damage.
→ This trait is shared with the Forked Hatchet.

Though this weapon scales better with Dexterity than with Strength, a hybrid Strength/Dexterity gains a bit more Attack Power than a pure Dexterity build (522 one-handed and 552 two-handed for the former vs. 509 one-handed and 522 two-handed for the latter).
Upgraded with regular Smithing Stones in spite of being uninfusable.
Essentially just an uninfusable Forked Hatchet locked into a bad skill.

weapons.name: Battle Axe

skill.name: Wild Strikes

notes: The Unique Skill: Rosus's Summons is very similar to the Tibia's Summons Sorcery in terms of both visuals and functionality. The three major differences is that Rosus's Summons has a melee hitbox when the axe swings down, that it deals significantly more damage than the Sorcery under most circumstances, and that the Sorcery has considerably more range due to the skeletons spawning adjacent to the target rather than the user.
→ Note that while the user's own attack is fairly interruptible, the spawned skeletons will attack as long as they were created.

→ The reason for the greater damage of the skill is twofold: for one, the Axe swing takes the total damage multiplier to 11% more than the Sorcery's, and for two, the Axe has at least 60% more Attack Power than even the Lusat's Glintstone Staff has Sorcery Scaling.

Rosus' Axe scales the best with Strength, with the Dexterity and Intelligence scalings not lagging too far behind. Overall, a pure Strength or hybrid Strength/Dexterity or Strength/Intelligence build gains the most Attack Power.

→ For example, at +10 the Axe has 736 Attack Power (AP) (765 AP when two-handed) with 80 Strength, 716 AP (765 AP when two-handed) with 45 Strength and 45 Dexterity, 717 AP (766 AP when two-handed) with 45 Strength and 45 Intelligence, and 660 AP (691 AP when two-handed) with 80 Intelligence.

notes: The Unique Skill: Blinkbolt: Twinaxe causes the player to turn into a bolt of lightning as they dash forward. Inputting the strong attack button during the dash will cause the player to perform several spinning slashes with the axes.
→ The Attack Power of this Unique Skill is boosted by the Death Knight Set.

→ While the initial dash is really only useful for the movement and Invincibility Frames it grants, the follow-up attack is capable of inflicting heavy damage, especially if combined with multi-hit damage boosters such as the Winged Sword Insignias.
→→ The follow-up attack is fairly easily avoidable by jumping.
The Death Knight's Twin Axes are paired weapons; two-handing the axe will cause the player to equip a second axe in their off-hand.

A pure Strength or hybrid Strength/Dexterity build gets the most Attack Power, with a hybrid Strength/Faith build being a bit behind.

skill.name: Kick
skill.description: Push an enemy back with a high kick. Effective against enemies who are guarding, and can break a foe's stance. Sometimes a simple tool is the most effective.

weapons.description:
Great hammer comprised of a globe attached to a handle. Though a bludgeon dealing strike damage, the appellative star is covered in spikes which cause blood loss.

Ironic given its graceful name, this weapon often reeks of blood.

details: Found in a broken down black carriage south of Bridge of Sacrifice and Irina in the Weeping Peninsula region.

estimate_if_undocumented.basis: 75 of 92 wiki-documented weapons with a non-unique skill use regular Smithing Stones

notes: The Morning Star has unique thrusting attacks on the last hit of its light attack chain, as well as its running heavy, rolling light, and backstep light attacks. These attacks are also used with the Scepter of the All-Knowing.
→ Despite being unlisted, these attacks deal Pierce damage.

The Morning Star is a great early game weapon as it deals high base damage, has innate Bleed, can be wielded by all the Origins without having to level up their stats (some Origins might have to two-hand it) and can be found in the Weeping Peninsula.
→ Although the Spiked Club is a bit stronger for Occult Affinity, that weapon requires farming specific enemies to acquire.
Has very short range.

weapons.name: Warpick

skill.name: Kick
skill.description: Push an enemy back with a high kick. Effective against enemies who are guarding, and can break a foe's stance. Sometimes a simple tool is the most effective.

weapons.description:
Great hammer with a hard protruding beak. A pickaxe designed for combat, in essence.

A simple but highly effective weapon, the weighty piercing attack casually rips through metal armor.

acquisition.location: Limgrave / Weeping Peninsula / Liurnia of the Lakes / Caelid / Altus Plateau / Deeproot Depths / Consecrated Snowfield / Miquella's Haligtree
details: Soldier enemies of every faction that wield this weapon have a 2% drop rate for it.
→ This includes Godrick Soldiers, Raya Lucaria Soldiers, Radahn Soldiers, Leyndell Soldiers, Mausoleum Soldiers, and Haligtree Soldiers.
→ 2 warpick-wielders can be found hiding in the bushes at the west end of Gatefront, which can be easily reached from the Stormhill Shack Site of Grace.
→ 2 warpick-wielders can be found in a small camp east of the Agheel Lake South Site of Grace.

upgrade.material_info_source: deduced (wiki shows the weapon accepts Ashes of War/affinities; somber weapons cannot)

notes: The Warpick and the Flowerstone Gavel are the only two Hammers to deal pure Pierce damage with their Physical damage.
→ Due to this, all of their attacks are boosted by the Spear Talisman, especially so when using physical Affinities.
Of above average length but also consistently has the lowest Attack Power of all infusable hammers.

patch_notes.official_notes: Fixed the physical attack attribute menu display of the “Warpick” weapon.
patch_notes.community_notes: Prior to this update the weapon's statistics would display "Strike" as its Physical damage type, though mechanically speaking it has always dealt Pierce damage.

weapons.name: Hammer

skill.name: Kick
skill.description: Push an enemy back with a high kick. Effective against enemies who are guarding, and can break a foe's stance. Sometimes a simple tool is the most effective.

weapons.description:
Hammer comprised of a large stone affixed to a metal handle. Originally a blacksmith's tool.

The art of smithing is said to have originated among the giants. This weapon's striking attacks boast ample weight behind them.

details: The Hammer is located on the upper floor of the Fortified Manor to the left of the entrance window, right next to the Sanctified Whetblade.
→ This is the same spot where Smithing Master Hewg sits in Roundtable Hold.

upgrade.material_info_source: deduced (wiki shows the weapon accepts Ashes of War/affinities; somber weapons cannot)

notes: Though this is technically only the second or third strongest infusable hammer, though in comparison with the other two, the Spiked Club and the Stone Club, the Hammer is much easier to get than the both and for the former the Hammer outclasses it on more physical Affinities and for the latter the Hammer is slightly lighter and has somewhat lower wielding requirements.

Though it gains the most Attack Power when using Heavy affinity that affinity actually has slightly weaker Strength-scaling for "bullet"-type (i.e. doesn't scale directly with the used weapon's damage) Skills with a Heavy, Quality, or Fire Affinity, giving them usually about 2% less damage than they otherwise would have. This includes, as an example, the skills Ground Slam and Flame of the Redmanes (these skills however perform as normal on any affinity besides Heavy).
This is the third longest hammer, being just barely outreached by Scepter of the All-Knowing and Ringed Finger.

weapons.name: Monk's Flamemace
weapons.japanese_name: 僧兵の炎姿槌 (Sōhei no Honō Sugata Tsuchi)

skill.name: Kick
skill.description: Push an enemy back with a high kick. Effective against enemies who are guarding, and can break a foe's stance. Sometimes a simple tool is the most effective.

weapons.description:
Great hammer made to resemble flickering flames. Signature weapon of the Fire Monks, who hail from the Mountaintops of the Giants.

The unique strong attack rouses fiery combative spirit.

acquisition.location: Liurnia of the Lakes / Fort Laiedd / Mountaintops of the Giants
details: 4% drop chance from mace-wielding Fire Monks.
→ Mace-wielding Blackflame Monks cannot drop this weapon.
→ A camp with two Fire Monks can be found at a camp southwest of the Scenic Isle Site of Grace in southern Liurnia.
→ A lone Fire Monk can be found southeast of the Eastern Tablelands Site of Grace in eastern Liurnia, with a camp also being to the southwest of the Site of Grace.
→ One such Fire Monk can be found just past the entrance & Site of Grace of Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave.

estimate_if_undocumented.basis: 75 of 92 wiki-documented weapons with a non-unique skill use regular Smithing Stones

notes: Has unique heavy and charged heavy attacks that are slightly slower in exchange for being slightly stronger.

→ More specifically, one- and two-handed the second heavy attacks has a flat 10% higher Attack Power while charged heavy attacks have flat 10% and 20% higher Attack Power for the first and second attack respectively.

→ The heavy attacks are 3-5 frames/0.10-0.17 seconds slower while the charged heavy attacks are 7-8 frames/0.23-0.27 seconds slower for the first one and 17 frames/0.57 seconds slower for the second one.
Performs best on the Keen and Occult Affinities, and fairly well on other, non-Heavy Affinities.

→ Despite this its Keen affinity actually gives it slightly weaker Dexterity-scaling for "bullet"-type (i.e. doesn't scale directly with the used weapon's damage) Skills with a Keen, Quality, Lightning, or Cold affinity, giving them usually about 2% less damage than they otherwise would have. This includes, as an example, the skills Beast's Roar, Thunderbolt, and Hoarfrost Stomp (these skills however perform as normal on any affinity besides Keen).
Of above average length for a hammer.

weapons.name: Varré's Bouquet
weapons.japanese_name: ヴァレーの花束 (Varē no Hanataba)

skill.name: Blood Tax
skill.description: Blood Oath skill granted by the Lord of Blood. Twist to build power, then unleash a flurry of thrusts that rob the target of both their blood and their HP.

weapons.description:
A steel mace resembling a charming bouquet of roses. Each petal has a sharpened edge, leaving the roses perpetually colored with blood.

This weapon reflects White Mask Varré's manner of speech rather well, enticing in its splendor, but full of deadly consequence.

details: Progress White Mask Varré's questline and then touch his invasion sign located just before the Dynasty Mausoleum Midpoint Site of Grace. Defeat him in his world and then he'll be lying on the ground near where his invasion sign was. Talk to him and exhaust his dialogue, and then he'll drop Varré's Bouquet upon his death.

notes: Varré's Bouquet has Blood Tax as its innate skill.
→ Though using this skill is made somewhat difficult by the weapon's below average length, the health recovery and status affliction of the skill can still be useful.

Despite being a Somber weapon, Varré's Bouquet is able to be buffed with consumables like Blood Grease and Soporific Grease. At high levels of Arcane, Varré's Bouquet is able to quickly inflict Poison, Blood Loss, or Sleep with these items.
→ At maximum upgrade level Varré's Bouquet will get 127% Status Effect build-up at 24 Arcane, 168% Status Effect build-up at 45 Arcane, and 177% Status Effect build-up at 80 Arcane.
→ Varré's Bouquet can also be buffed with spells like Bloodflame Blade to inflict more Blood Loss. However, since Bloodflame Blood doesn't scale with Arcane, this isn't as effective as using Greases.
Starting from 36 Arcane and beyond, Varré's Bouquet will inflict higher Blood Loss build-up than any of the other Hammers infused with Blood Affinity.
→ In addition to this the Bouquet gets the most Attack Power from a pure Arcane build, trailed slightly by a hybrid Dexterity/Arcane build.

Varré's Bouquet is commonly regarded as one of the worst weapons in the game. It is one of the shortest Hammers, has incredibly weak Attack Power, and cannot be infused with other Ashes of War. Outside of inflicting Blood Loss, Varré's Bouquet is generally outclassed by every other Hammer.

weapons.name: Envoy's Horn
weapons.japanese_name: 使者たちの笛 (Shisha-tachi no Fue)

skill.name: Oracular Bubble
skill.description: Blow on the horn to release a magic bubble. The bubble floats gently through the air towards its target.

weapons.description:
Golden horn of the Oracle Envoys. Profoundly weighty, its blows are sure to be felt.

Originally an instrument, but one that cannot be sounded by a mere human. Or perhaps it is too early to sound the call.

details: 2% drop chance from small Oracle Envoys.
→ 5 small Envoys (and 1 medium one) can be found west of the East Capital Rampart Site of Grace, just at the entrance to Leyndell, Royal Capital.
→ 3 small Envoys can be found just south of the West Capital Rampart Site of Grace in Leyndell, guarded by a non-respawning Valiant Gargoyle.
→ Many small Envoys can be found near the Haligtree Canopy Site of Grace at the start of the Haligtree, which unlike the other two spots is permanently available.

upgrade.changeability_info_source: wiki (Ash of War-Compatible Armaments) + deduced (affinity_changeable: wiki rule, a weapon upgraded with Somber Smithing Stones takes no Ash of War, hence no affinity)

estimate_if_undocumented.basis: 57 of 58 wiki-documented weapons with a Unique Skill use Somber Smithing Stones

notes: The Unique Skill: Oracular Bubble is a decently strong but slow Holy ranged attack with tracking, useful as a ranged option.
There is a conflict between the weapon's scaling, which benefits primarily from Dexterity and then from Strength, and the skill's scaling, which depends entirely on Faith (and weapon upgrade level).

→ For comparison, a hybrid Strength/Dexterity build gains the most Attack Power for the weapon at the cost of 20% lower Attack Power for the skill, a pure Faith build 15% weapon Attack Power in exchange for keeping the skill at full strength, and a hybrid Strength/Faith or Dexterity/Faith build is in the middle with 5% lower weapon Attack Power and 10% lower skill Attack Power from their respective maximums.
Of average length for a hammer.

weapons.name: Nox Flowing Hammer
weapons.japanese_name: ノクスの流体槌 (Nokusu no Ryūtai Tsuchi)

skill.name: Flowing Form
skill.description: Temporarily transforms armament into its liquid form. Swing the armament like a whip to perform a sweeping slice over a wide area.

weapons.description:
Mace shaped like a suspended metal droplet wielded by monks of the Eternal City.

Forged from liquid metal from a Silver Tear, it is thoroughly tempered until hardened.

details: Found on a corpse in Night's Sacred Ground, located in Nokron, Eternal City. It is found near the Mimic Tear Ashes.

→ From the Ancestral Woods Site of Grace, head down into the Eternal City until you reach the room with a Giant Silver Tear. Head to the side corridor with a Stonesword Key Gate to the chest with the Mimic Tear Ashes and jump out a window to the right onto the roof, then through another window on the right to a small stone bridge where the Flowing Hammer can be found.
→ Alternatively, start at the Night's Sacred Ground Site of Grace, going up the stairs and then a ladder to the Stonesword Key gate to get on the route above.

upgrade.changeability_info_source: wiki (Ash of War-Compatible Armaments) + deduced (affinity_changeable: wiki rule, a weapon upgraded with Somber Smithing Stones takes no Ash of War, hence no affinity)

estimate_if_undocumented.basis: 57 of 58 wiki-documented weapons with a Unique Skill use Somber Smithing Stones

notes: The version of Unique Skill: Flowing Form found on this weapon is a wide, spinning sweep followed by an overhead slam that knocks down roughly Tarnished-sized foes.

→ Though it is quite useful against other players, it is ironically somewhat weaker than the Nox Flowing Sword's variant of it since the Hammer's version deals less Stance damage despite being made with a hammer.

Unsurprisingly, since the Strength-scaling is the strongest scaling on this weapon a pure Strength build gets the most Attack Power, though a hybrid Strength/Dexterity build or a Strength build with a decent amount of Dexterity can get pretty close.
This is the shortest of all hammers.

weapons.name: Ringed Finger

skill.name: Claw Flick
skill.description: Cause the finger to swell, then flex to build up strength before giving enemies an almighty flick.

weapons.description:
Bludgeon made of an enormous finger sheathed in several heavy rings. Thought to have been cut from an ancestor of the Fingercreeper.

Some life yet remains in this legacy of an ancient act of blasphemy, as evidenced by the barely perceptible warmth it still exudes.

details: Found in a chest at the end of the initial lava-filled path in the Gelmir Hero's Grave, guarded by a Chariot.

→ The first half or so of the path consist of running from cubbyhole to cubbyhole, but the second half is just lava that inflicts low damage slows down movement. Either backstepping or using the Skill: Quickstep can make traversing that second section much simpler.

upgrade.changeability_info_source: wiki (Ash of War-Compatible Armaments) + deduced (affinity_changeable: wiki rule, a weapon upgraded with Somber Smithing Stones takes no Ash of War, hence no affinity)

estimate_if_undocumented.basis: 57 of 58 wiki-documented weapons with a Unique Skill use Somber Smithing Stones

notes: The Unique Skill: Claw Flick starts with a staggering, non-damaging swelling before flicking the finger to deal heavy damage and inflict knockback.

→ The initial swelling is somewhat subtle and can stunlock someone into the flick, making this skill surprisingly dangerous. In addition, it inflicts as much Stance damage as a charged heavy attack (36).

Strength has the strongest scaling on this weapon so a pure Strength build is the easiest way to get high Attack Power with it, though a hybrid Strength/Dexterity build also comes pretty close and a Strength build with some Dexterity can get higher Attack Power when two-handed.
Has surprisingly poor Stamina damage for a hammer, better than only the Scepter of the All-Knowing.
This is the longest hammer in the base game.

weapons.name: Scepter of the All-Knowing
weapons.japanese_name: 百智の王笏 (Hyaku Tomo no ō Kotsu)

skill.name: Knowledge Above All
skill.description: Raise the scepter to manifest the realm of the All-Knowing. Enemy magic and holy damage negation will be reduced for all entities within the area, including the caster.

weapons.description:
Scepter in the form of a hand grasping a pearl. Signature weapon of Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing.

The pearl stands for the world, the heavens, and an eye, representing the many forms of knowledge, never fully attainable. Even knowing that, the All-Knowing's hand grasps for it.

details: Defeat Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing.

upgrade.changeability_info_source: wiki (Ash of War-Compatible Armaments) + deduced (affinity_changeable: wiki rule, a weapon upgraded with Somber Smithing Stones takes no Ash of War, hence no affinity)

estimate_if_undocumented.basis: 57 of 58 wiki-documented weapons with a Unique Skill use Somber Smithing Stones

notes: The Unique Skill: Knowledge Above All is an aoe debuff that decreases the Magic and Holy Damage Negations of both the user and their enemies.
→ Since the skill also affects the user (but not their allies) it's best used against enemies with access to neither damage type.

The Scepter of the All-Knowing has a unique thrusting attack on the last hit of its light attack chain, running heavy, rolling light, and backstep light attacks. These attacks are also used with the Morning Star.
→ the Scepter of the All-Knowing deals Pierce damage, allowing it to take advantage of counter hits with the thrusting attacks.
Though the Dexterity- and Intelligence-scalings are equal, the fact that the base Physical Attack Power is roughly 50% greater makes the former more effective.

→ This means a pure Dexterity build gets the most Attack Power, followed by a hybrid Strength/Dexterity or Dexterity/Intelligence build, and finally a pure Intelligence build has roughly 10% less Attack Power than the strongest build.
→ It should be noted that of the three attributes, only Intelligence aligns with either of the two Damage Negations decreased by the skill.
Has the worst Stamina damage for a hammer, about 20% lower than the average and more on par with a Curved Sword.
This is the second longest hammer in the base game.

weapons.name: Flowerstone Gavel

skill.name: Flower Dragonbolt
skill.description: Calls down the red lightning of the ancient dragons to strike a target. Deals lightning damage and also temporarily reduces the target's lightning damage negation. Can be charged to increase its power.

weapons.description:
Weapon of the Dragon Communion priestess. A dragonstone hammer resembling an ancient flower.

The four petals and the flower's core are all sharp, ending in points, and are capable of dealing heavy damage to dragons.

details: The Flowerstone Gavel (and the Priestess Heart) will be where the Dragon Communion Priestess once stood at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion after Bayle the Dread is defeated.
→ WARNING: If the Dragon Communion Priestess is given Thiollier's Concoction, she will not leave this item. Instead the player will receive her spirit ash and spell.

upgrade.changeability_info_source: wiki (Ash of War-Compatible Armaments) + deduced (affinity_changeable: wiki rule, a weapon upgraded with Somber Smithing Stones takes no Ash of War, hence no affinity)

estimate_if_undocumented.basis: 57 of 58 wiki-documented weapons with a Unique Skill use Somber Smithing Stones

notes: Flower Dragonbolt calls down a bolt of red lightning onto an enemy. If the lightning bolt hits, the enemy will suffer a -23% (-12% in PvP) reduction to their Lightning Damage Negation for 20 seconds.
→ Flower Dragonbolt can be charged to inflict extra damage in addition to reducing an enemy's Lightning Damage Negation to -30% (-17% in PvP).
→ This debuff counts as a Power Shred debuff à la Shriek of Milos or Greyoll's Roar.
The Flowerstone Gavel deals +30% extra damage against Dragons and +15% against Ancient Dragons.
The Flowerstone Gavel and the Warpick are the only two Hammers to deal pure Pierce damage.
→ Due to this, all of their attacks are boosted by the Spear Talisman.
The Strength- and Arcane-scalings are equally strong, leading to a hybrid Strength/Arcane build gaining the most Attack Power.

→ That said, a pure Arcane build is arguably better since the skill scales with that stat and the easiest source of Lightning damage to synergise with it is Dragon Cult Incantations cast through the Dragon Communion Seal.

weapons.name: Marika's Hammer

skill.name: Gold Breaker
skill.description:
Leap up high and, while suspended in midair, imbue the rune shard with light before smashing it down hard onto the ground.
The heroic Radagon's signature attack.

weapons.description:
Stone hammer made in the lands of the Numen, outside the Lands Between. The tool with which Queen Marika shattered the Elden Ring and Radagon attempted to repair it.

The hammer partially broke upon shattering the Ring, becoming splintered with rune fragments.

details: Trade the Elden Remembrance, gained by defeating the Elden Beast, with Finger Reader Enia.
→ Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

upgrade.changeability_info_source: wiki (Ash of War-Compatible Armaments) + deduced (affinity_changeable: wiki rule, a weapon upgraded with Somber Smithing Stones takes no Ash of War, hence no affinity)

estimate_if_undocumented.basis: 57 of 58 wiki-documented weapons with a Unique Skill use Somber Smithing Stones

notes: The Unique Skill: Gold Breaker is effectively a jumping slam followed by a golden shockwave that launches enemies into the sky. Most of the damage comes from the shockwave but the slam deals much more Stance damage.
→ Though this skill is a bit slow, its heavy damage and Stance damage combined with the wide attack radius plus ability to launch foes gives it a fairly wide amount of usages.
→ This skills counts as a jump, meaning it can avoid certain ground-bound attacks.

Though it looks fairly strong, Faith is actually this weapon's weakest scaling since it only applies to the lower Holy Attack Power instead of the higher Physical Attack Power. Strength however is as useful as it seems and Dexterity isn't that far behind.

→ A pure Strength build gets the most one-handed Attack Power while a hybrid Strength/Dexterity build is a bit stronger when two-handed, with a hybrid Strength/Faith build lagging a bit behind those two alternatives.
Of average length.

weapons.name: Flail

skill.name: Spinning Chain
skill.type: Standard skill (no Ash of War item)
skill.description: Spins the striking part of a flail at high speed to attack. Follow up with a normal or strong attack to link the momentum of this skill into a successive attack.

weapons.description:
Weapon consisting of a bludgeoning head attached to a handle by a chain. The iron ball is spiked and induces blood loss.

Blows from this weapon cannot be parried. The charge attack whirls the iron ball around for increased force before striking.

details: Found near Gatefront Ruins, located in the black carriage furthest east from Gatefront's marker.
Dropped by Brother Corhyn at any point during his questline depending on the player's actions. It can also be obtained by killing him.

estimate_if_undocumented.basis: 75 of 92 wiki-documented weapons with a non-unique skill use regular Smithing Stones

notes: The Flail makes for a decent early game Strike weapon, especially for builds that lean towards Dexterity.

→ Otherwise, it is rather mediocre except for the innate Blood Loss and being unparryable. Even more so since the Nightrider Flail will eventually slightly outclass it in terms of Attack Power and length.
The second shortest Flail weapon in the game.

weapons.name: Nightrider Flail
weapons.japanese_name: 夜騎兵のフレイル (Yoru Kihei no Fureiru)

skill.name: Spinning Chain
skill.type: Standard skill (no Ash of War item)
skill.description: Spins the striking part of a flail at high speed to attack. Follow up with a normal or strong attack to link the momentum of this skill into a successive attack.

weapons.description:
A flail with two additional bludgeoning heads. Weapon of the Night's Cavalry who ride funeral steeds.

The large spikes make it highly effective at inducing blood loss, but also demand higher dexterity to wield.

details: Drop from the Night's Cavalry located in the Weeping Peninsula, found near the Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace at night.

estimate_if_undocumented.basis: 75 of 92 wiki-documented weapons with a non-unique skill use regular Smithing Stones

notes: Favors Dexterity more than the other Flails.

→ When using its Keen affinity it actually has slightly weaker Dexterity-scaling for "bullet"-type (i.e. doesn't scale directly with the used weapon's damage) Skills with a Keen, Quality, Lightning, or Cold affinity, giving them usually about 2% less damage than they otherwise would have. This includes, as an example, the skills Beast's Roar, Thunderbolt, and Hoarfrost Stomp (these skills however perform as normal on any affinity besides Keen).
One of the longest flails, on par with the Chainlink Flail and Family Heads.
Unlike the Nightrider Glaive, this weapon DOES NOT get a damage bonus when riding Torrent.

weapons.name: Chainlink Flail

skill.name: Spinning Chain
skill.type: Standard skill (no Ash of War item)
skill.description: Spins the striking part of a flail at high speed to attack. Follow up with a normal or strong attack to link the momentum of this skill into a successive attack.

weapons.description:
A spiked iron tube attached by a chain wielded by Mad Pumpkin Heads.

Especially large for a flail, wielding it requires more strength than it does dexterity.

acquisition.location: Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau
details: 4% drop chance from the Mad Pumpkin Head enemies that wield it.

→ The earliest spot to farm is just outside of Fort Haight, as a Mad Pumpkin Head (and several Godrick Soldiers) guard the entrance to the fort as long as the Blood-Obsessed Godrick Knight atop it hasn't been killed.
→ Just north of the Foot of the Four Belfries Site of Grace in western Liurnia is a camp with some Raya Lucaria Soldiers and two Mad Pumpkin Heads, one of which wields this flail.

→ At the Road of Iniquity Side Path Site of Grace in northern Altus Plateau, west of Dominula, Windmill Village and north of a Minor Erdtree, is a carriage traveling west, guarded by numerous Leyndell Soldiers and a flail-wielding Mad Pumpkin Head in the back. There is also another Pumpkin Head a bit north of the carriage's starting point, at the edge of the cliffs.

upgrade.material_info_source: deduced (wiki shows the weapon accepts Ashes of War/affinities; somber weapons cannot)

notes: The Chainlink Flail is more oriented towards Strength than Dexterity.
→ When infused with the Heavy Affinity, the Chainlink Flail will receive an S-scaling in Strength.

→ When using its Heavy affinity it actually has slightly weaker Strength-scaling for "bullet"-type (i.e. doesn't scale directly with the used weapon's damage) Skills with a Heavy, Quality, or Fire Affinity, giving them usually about 2% less damage than they otherwise would have. This includes, as an example, the skills Ground Slam and Flame of the Redmanes (these skills however perform as normal on any affinity besides Heavy).
The Chainlink Flail is the heaviest Flail in the game.

weapons.name: Family Heads

skill.name: Familial Rancor
skill.description:
Gently rattle the copper heads to summon vengeful spirits that chase down foes.
The anguish of a spouse and children invites accursed wrath.

weapons.description:
Three bludgeoning copper heads attached to a handle by chains. Signature weapon of Necromancer Garris, the heretical sage.

The heads were made to resemble those of his wife and two children.

details: Received upon defeating Necromancer Garris, who is found behind two illusory walls in a row inside the Sage's Cave.

→ More specifically, the first illusory wall is found on the first platform to the left in the room with a waterfall just before the other boss of the Cave, while the other is to the right of the two chests the first illusory wall hides.

notes: This weapon is upgraded with Somber Smithing Stones.
Can't be buffed or infused.
The Unique Skill: Familial Rancor releases up to 7 magical skulls in sequence which move slowly but have heavy tracking against their target.
→ Curiously enough, the skill does not consume Stamina upon casting, even in combat.
→ The skill can be roll-cancelled mid-casting at two points, after releasing 4 and 5 skulls respectively.
While the weapon itself mostly scales with Dexterity, the skill actually scales with Intelligence and quite strongly at that in spite of the weapon's own E to D scaling for that Attribute.

→ For comparison, at 80 Dexterity and 16 Intelligence the weapon has 671 total Attack Power of which 158 is Magic Attack Power, at 45 Dexterity and 45 Intelligence the weapon has 598 total Attack Power of which 179 is Magic Attack Power, and at 18 Dexterity and 80 Intelligence the weapon has 497 total Attack Power of which 190 is Magic Attack Power. Using the initial setup as the baseline, the 45/45 Dexterity/Intelligence split decreases total Attack Power by 11% but increases Magic Attack Power by 13% while the 80 Intelligence one decreases total Attack Power by 26% but increases Magic Attack Power by 20%.

weapons.name: Serpent Flail
weapons.japanese_name: 蛇のフレイル (Hebi no Fureiru)

skill.name: Flare, O Serpent
skill.description:
Ignites a flame inside the snakes, temporarily empowering flame attacks.

Once ignited, strong attacks and other moves that strike the ground will cause an explosion.

weapons.description:
A flail with coiled snakes for bludgeoning heads. Fire roars within the snakes' bodies, inflicting horrible burns.

Some of Messmer's army used these flails to burn hornsent—to brand them with agony and fear.

details: This weapon can be found inside a chest within Fog Rift Fort.

notes: The Serpent Flail cannot be buffed by spells or any consumables.
The Serpent Flail cannot have its Ash of War or Affinity changed.

Flare, O Serpent coats the Serpent Flail in Messmerfire, granting the weapon an additional 90 Fire Attack Power for 30 seconds. A strong attack or any other attack that makes the Serpent Flail hit the ground will cause the Messmerfire to explode.
→ Flare, O Serpent is a Fire Knight skill, meaning it gets a +10% and a +8% Attack Power increase from the Winged Serpent Helm and Messmer's Helm respectively.
Despite its high Dexterity requirement, the Serpent Flail scales a bit better with Faith especially since it also increases the strength of the skill's explosion.
→ For comparison, 80 Faith grants 649 Attack Power, 45 Faith and 45 Dexterity grants 631 Attack Power, and 80 Dexterity grants 612 Attack Power.

weapons.name: Golden Order Flail

skill.name: Causality's Wrath
skill.description: A skill which houses the wheel of causality within the user's frame. Once activated, perform an additional input to unleash an attack. The potency of the attack builds charge tiers based on the number of hits taken.

weapons.description:
A flail with three golden rings for striking heads, the sacred signature weapon of the esteemed Broken Mask.

The golden bands are modelled upon the Elden Ring itself, half-corporeal and half formed of light, all in the process of shattering.

details: Obtained after defeating The Noble Broken Mask invader in Leyndell, Royal Capital, who appears after using Law of Regression on the Radagon statue found after an elevator beside the Erdtree Sanctuary Site of Grace.

estimate_if_undocumented.basis: 57 of 58 wiki-documented weapons with a Unique Skill use Somber Smithing Stones

acquisition.location: Can be picked up within the boss arena of Praetor Rykard.
details: This item does not re-spawn when the player has one in either their inventory or chest, even in NG+. However it will re-spawn (and thus can be picked up again) from the same location should the player discard it. This is to make sure that the player always have the means of fighting Rykard with it.
Because of this safeguard it is still possible to obtain duplicates of this weapon:
Requirements:
→ The player needs to not have a copy of it in their inventory.
→ Rykard needs to still be alive.
→ The game needs to be in online-mode.

1) Stand outside Rykard's arena and attempt to connect to another player's world through any means necessary. (Tarnished's Furled Finger, Duelist's Furled Finger, Bloody Finger, Recusant Finger, Festering Bloody Finger or Blue Cipher Ring)
2) When the game has successfully found a world it can try to connect to, enter Rykard's arena and pick up the Serpent-Hunter before the Loading Screen appears.
3) Leave the multiplayer session either by completing your objective or using the Finger Severer.

4) When you re-spawn back in your own world, do not fast travel or rest at the Sites of Grace, instead enter Rykard's arena again and you'll see the Serpent Hunter is still there, available to be picked up again for a second time. (Traveling or resting at the site of grace will make the game check if the Serpent-Hunter is in your inventory before it decides if it'll spawn in a new one for you to pick up)
It's possible to obtain even more copies of this weapon if the player simply loops back to step 1 after finishing step 3.

The Unique Skill, Bloodfiend's Bloodboon, is similar in a lot of ways to Bloodboon Ritual, mainly in the animation, the AOE, and the Fire damage it deals. However, instead of the AOE being placed around the player, Bloodfiend's Bloodboon is ranged.

→ Unfortunately, Bloodfiends' Bloodboon in a lot of ways is worse than Bloodboon Ritual. Bloodfiends' Bloodboon contains no tracking, deals very little damage, does not provide a Weapon Buff to the Bloodfiend's Sacred Spear, and frequently gets caught on terrian, all while being as slow and costing the same amount of FP as Bloodboon Ritual.
The Bloodfiend's Sacred Spear can be considered a lesser version of Mohgwyn's Sacred Spear, but with a few differences:

→ The Bloodfiend's Sacred Spear deals only Physical damage while Mohgwyn's Sacred Spear is split between Physical and Fire, meaning that the Bloodfiend's Sacred Spear can take better advantage of the Spear Talisman due to dealing pure Pierce damage. However, the Attack Power of Mohgwyn's Sacred Spear can be slightly increased by using Bloodboon Ritual while the Bloodfiend's Sacred Spear cannot be buffed at all.

→ The Bloodfiend's Sacred Spear is better suited for pure Arcane builds due to having a B-scaling in Arcane when it's fully upgraded while Mohgwyn's Sacred Spear is better suited for Strength/Arcane hybrid builds.
→ The Bloodfiend's Sacred Spear has considerably more Blood Loss build-up compared to Mohgwyn's Sacred Spear (129 vs 94 Blood Loss build-up when both weapons are at +10 and at 99 Arcane).

Even after his lord was fled, Commander O'Neil continued to brandish this flag in the devastation of the rot-eaten field of battle, the sole veteran who remembers this battle with pride.

Unique Skill: Rallying Standard

Hoist the war banner aloft and give a rallying command. Raises attack power and defense for self and nearby allies.

details: Received upon defeating Commander O'Neil in Aeonia Swamp located in Caelid.

Sharp blade sculpted into a twisted shape. A glaive that has seen many years of use in the gravesite.

Said to serve as a medium for communion with spirits.

skill.description: Imbues bud-blade with scarlet rot butterflies before unleashing two large sweeping slashes. This was once considered a sacred act of purification.

weapons.description:
Weapon of Romina, Saint of the Bud. A scarlet glaive with a dangling bud-like blade. Attacks cause buildup of rot.

Once, in the crumbling, burning church, Romina held the bud in speechless silence. That bud would become her blade.

acquisition.location: Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud
details: Trade the Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold.

Large scythe featuring a long, slender blade. Designed to reap, this weapon is capable of rapidly inflicting blood loss while also slipping through an enemy's guard.

In the hands of a highly dexterous wielder it is capable of striking fear into the heart of any foe.

details: Cliffbottom Catacombs, southeast Liurnia of the Lakes. On a boddy in the upper floor, guarded by four stone Imps.

Summon Miquella's shining halo and fire it forwards.
Can be fired in rapid succession.

War scythe of the Cleanrot Knights who fought alongside Malenia, Blade of Miquella.

This was the weapon of commanders in Malenia's army, and the half-halo blade deals holy damage.

Unique Skill: Miquella's Ring of Light

Summon Miquella's shining halo and fire it forwards. Can be fired in rapid succession.

details: Dropped by Cleanrot Knights.

Sacred scythe resembling a pair of white wings. Deals holy damage.

According to pagan belief, white-winged maidens are said to be Death's gentle envoys.

details: Found underground in the Tombsward Ruins, on the Weeping Peninsula.

Signature weapon of the Pureblood Knight Ansbach. A viciously keen and slender scythe made for combat.

The obsidian edge relies not upon trickery to fulfil its violent purpose—through skill alone the wielder can rip and rend through foes, sowing blossoms of red upon the battlefield.

details: Available after successfully assisting Sir Ansbach in his battle against Needle Knight Leda at the Specimen Storehouse. Then defeating Promised Consort Radahn. The item can be recovered from Ansbach's body, which can be found seated against one of the walls close to the entrance of the boss arena.

weapons.description:
A leather whip. Not originally used for combat, but as an instrument of pain.

Through its supple attacks cannot be thwarted by parrying or even guarding, it is incapable of dealing critical hits.

details: Castle Morne: Inside the second prison cell area reached by dropping down onto a couple of beams. The room is filled with rats and a misbegotten.

Hefty whip covered in crimson thorns. Weapon of the Prelates who lead the Fire Monks. A device of fearsome religious encouragement, it is fashioned in the image of the briars of sin.

Very effective at inflicting blood loss.

This weapon made of extremely thin, flexible blades of metal is wielded like a whip by Nightfolk warriors.

Though in essence a whip with a cutting edge, it can also be used as a spear to pierce foes.

weapons.name: Hoslow's Petal Whip
weapons.japanese_name: ホスローの花弁 (Hosurō no Hanabira)

skill.name: Kick
skill.description: Push an enemy back with a high kick. Effective against enemies who are guarding, and can break a foe's stance. Sometimes a simple tool is the most effective.

weapons.description:
Metal whip formed of razor-sharp chain-link blades that have the appearance of flower petals. This work of art is handed down through the generations of the illustrious House Hoslow.

High dexterity is required to wield this weapon, but it excels at inflicting devastating blood loss. "The tale of House Hoslow is told in blood."

details: Dropped by Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood after invading him in the Mountaintops of the Giants for the final contract from Tanith, Volcano Manor Proprietress.
Dropped by Diallos at the end of his questline.

notes: The damage formula when inflicting Blood Loss on a non-Blood-infused Hoslow's Petal Whip is (10.5% + 200) instead of the typical (10.5% + 100). This makes Hoslow's Petal Whip the only weapon in the game to deal extra damage when inflicting Bleed without being a Somber weapon or needing the Blood Affinity.
Hoslow's Petal Whip has the second highest Dexterity requirements for the Whips; the first being the Tooth Whip Shadow of the Erdtree.
Hoslow's Petal Whip is the only other Whip with innate Bleed, with the other one being the Thorned Whip.
Hoslow's Petal Whip is the second-shortest Whip in the game; the shortest is the Magma Whip Candlestick.

weapons.name: Tooth Whip

skill.name: Painful Strike
skill.description: A chastening whip strike, honed to maximize pain. Temporarily reduces the rate at which stamina recovers. Thus does the pain encourage obedience.

weapons.description:
Whip bestrewn with rotting, misshapen teeth. Filthy and seething with disease, the teeth are embedded in the whip and dose the victim with deadly poison upon each strike.

As the wounds ripen they grow inflamed and ooze pus. The flesh of shamans was said to meld harmoniously with others.

details: Pillaged from a corpse inside the whipping hut.

notes: The Tooth Whip cannot be buffed by spells or consumables.
The Tooth Whip cannot have its Skill or Affinity changed.
Painful Strike, the weapon's Unique Skill, reduces the enemy's stamina recovery speed by -8/s (17.7%) for 30 seconds.
The Tooth Whip inflicts Deadly Poison. However, due to not having any Arcane scaling, the Deadly Poison build-up is flat.
Can be sold to merchants for 200.
Can be left for other players to pick up in online play.
Can be discarded.

weapons.name: Magma Whip Candlestick
weapons.japanese_name: 溶岩鞭の燭台 (Yōganben no Shokudai)

skill.name: Sea of Magma
skill.description: Swing a molten whip overhead to temporarily cover the surrounding area in a sea of magma. Hold to continue swinging the lava whip.

weapons.description:
This ritual implement is a three pronged candlestick with solid flames formed of the magma of Mt. Gelmir.

When wielded as a weapon, the flames become supple whips of lava.

details: The reward from Patches in Volcano Manor after defeating Great Horned Tragoth.

→ He won't give it to the player the first time he is spoken too. Instead, the area has to be reloaded in some way (either via teleporting or by exiting and re-entering the game) and he can be spoken to again to gain the weapon.

weapons.name: Giant's Red Braid

skill.name: Flame Dance
skill.description: Imbue the red braid with the Giants' Flame and lash out in a wide range with a series of agile swings.

weapons.description:
Hefty whip woven from the flame-red hair of a Fire Giant.

Every giant is red of hair, and Radagon was said to have despised his own red locks. Perhaps that was a curse of their kind.

details: Trade the Remembrance of the Fire Giant, gained by defeating Fire Giant, with Finger Reader Enia.
→ Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

notes: The Giant's Red Braid cannot be buffed by spells or any consumables.
The Giant's Red Braid cannot have its Ash of War or Affinity changed.
Flame Dance imbues the Giant's Red Braid with fire as the user swings it around. This skill has long range and hits multiple times.
One of the two Fire-based Whips in the game, the other being the Magma Whip Candlestick.
→ The Giant's Red Braid is better suited for Strength/Faith hybrid builds, while the Magma Whip Candlestick is better suited for Dexterity/Faith hybrid builds.
Strength will only increase the Physical Attack Power, while Faith only increases the Fire Attack Power.

Despite having a B in both Strength and Faith, the damage scales by far the best with Strength and as such, Strength/Faith builds with more points into the former than the latter is the best way to build for this weapon.

skill.name: Endure
skill.description:
Assume an anchored stance to brace for incoming attacks, briefly boosting poise.

Damage taken while using this skill is reduced.

weapons.description:
A weapon built for striking with the fists, made of rough leather inlaid with iron rivets.

Fist weapons come in pairs, and two-handling this weapon will equip it to both hands.

details: Sold by Gatekeeper Gostoc for 800 Runes.

estimate_if_undocumented.basis: 75 of 92 wiki-documented weapons with a non-unique skill use regular Smithing Stones

However, the early and easy availability of the Caestus makes it a worty pick up in the early game, especially since it's a Strike weapon.
The Caestus shares a unique multi-hit charged heavy attack with the Spiked Caestus.

weapons.name: Spiked Caestus

skill.name: Endure
skill.description:
Assume an anchored stance to brace for incoming attacks, briefly boosting poise.

Damage taken while using this skill is reduced.

weapons.description:
A caestus with the rivets replaced by blood loss-inducing spikes.

Fist weapons come in pair, and two-handling this weapon will equip it in both hands.

estimate_if_undocumented.basis: 75 of 92 wiki-documented weapons with a non-unique skill use regular Smithing Stones

The Spiked Caestus shares a unique multi-hit charged heavy attack with the Caestus.
When compared to the Star Fist, another Fist weapon with innate Bleed, the Spiked Caestus loses when it comes to damage, but will have higher Bleed build-up if infused with Occult or Blood.

weapons.name: Katar

skill.name: Impaling Thrust

skill.stamina_cost_wiki: 40 (39 for CSS Shadow of the Erdtree) (- -)

Despite what the in-game stats say, the Katar actually deals Standard damage, not Slash.
→ This is also true for the Clinging Bone and Veteran's Prosthesis.

skill.name: Impaling Thrust

skill.stamina_cost_wiki: 40 (39 for CSS Shadow of the Erdtree) (- -)

weapons.description:
A weapon comprised of a linear, double-sided blade attached to a substantial guard. Wielded by the Oathseeker Knights.

This versatile armament can be swung about like a fist or used in the manner of a straight sword.

details: Acquired from a corpse on a ledge by the front-entrance-way to the Church of Benediction.

upgrade.material_info_source: deduced (wiki shows the weapon accepts Ashes of War/affinities; somber weapons cannot)

notes: The Pata is the longest Fist weapon in the game bar none.
The Pata notably contains a true combo that was patched out from the Katar: a running heavy attack into a standing heavy attack.

Just like the Katar, the Pata has Impaling Thrust has its innate skill. Impaling Thrust is impossible to put on any other Fist weapon besides those two. However, should the player infuse the Pata with another Ash of War, Impaling Thrust will be lost as an option with no way to get it back.
Can be sold to merchants for 100.
Can be left for other players to pick up in online play.
Can be discarded.

Iron manifer of spherical shape. Big Boggart the blackguard's weapon of choice.

Not a weapon to be taken lightly, as its weighty blows shatter bones with ease.

Thrust the prosthetic leg blade into the ground, creating a storm.

Follow up with a strong attack to perform a lightning-infused jumping attack.

Bladed prosthetic leg enwreathed with the power of lightning, instead attached to the fist.

weapons.japanese_name: 秘文字のパタ (Himoji no Pata)

skill.name: Unblockable Blade
skill.description: Imbue the cipher blade with light, extending its length, then strike with a sudden sweeping attack. This attack cannot be blocked.

weapons.description:
One of the weapons originating from the Two Fingers. A formless sequence of ciphers comprise its blade, and as such no shield can repel it. Deals holy damage.

The furtive inscription appears to hang in the air; the language of light spoken by the Two Fingers.

details: Jump over the balcony rail in the Roundtable Hold, it will be in the rooms to the left.

upgrade.changeability_info_source: wiki (Ash of War-Compatible Armaments) + deduced (affinity_changeable: wiki rule, a weapon upgraded with Somber Smithing Stones takes no Ash of War, hence no affinity)

Aside from certain Sacred Seals, it is the only weapon in the game that weighs 0.
The Cipher Pata deals pure Holy damage and only scales with Faith, making it an amazing weapon for players that invest a lot of points into that attribute.
→ Due to this, despite what it says in-game, it is not capable of dealing Slash or Pierce damage as those are Physical attack types.
The Cipher Pata, along with the Coded Sword, have Tier 4 Hardness, enabling their attacks to bypass every shield type in the game and every enemy that has less than Tier 4 Hardness.
Due to being located inside the Roundtable Hold, the Cipher Pata is one of the earliest Faith weapons that can be obtained.

weapons.name: Poisoned Hand

skill.name: Poison Spear-Hand Strike
skill.description: Makes hand into the shape of a spear before unleashing a plunging stab that penetrates the body of the enemy. Afflicts foe with a large dose of deadly poison.

weapons.description: A glove stitched together from the flayed skin of the victims of a butcherous bloodbath. Afflicts target with deadly poison. Raises attack power when poisoning occurs in the vicinity. Forged of an unyielding, black impulse toward revenge fostered in those who have had everything burned or stolen from them, these are the weapons of the utterly downtrodden.

details: Found by the northern edge of the poison swamp that can only be accessed through the sewers. The Well Depths Key is needed to access this area.

The Poisoned Hand scales primarily with Arcane, both for its Attack Power and Poison build-up.

When Poison or Scarlet Rot is inflicted within the general vicinity (7 meters) of user while they have the Poisoned Hand in an active weapon slot, they will receive a +7.5% (+5% in PvP) increase to their Attack Power for 30 seconds.
→ This buff stacks with the Kindred of Rot's Exultation and the Mushroom Crown.
→ This buff activates even if the player doesn't meet the stat requirements for the weapon.

Can be left for other players to pick up in online play.
Can be discarded.

weapons.name: Madding Hand

skill.name: Madding Spear-Hand Strike
skill.description: Makes hand into the shape of a spear before unleashing a plunging stab that penetrates the body of the enemy. Afflicts foe with a large dose of madness.

weapons.description:
A glove stitched together from the flayed skin of the victims of a butcherous bloodbath. Afflicts target with madness. Raises attack power when madness is triggered in the vicinity.
Forged of an unyielding, black impulse toward revenge fostered in those who were hunted down as heretics by their own brethren, these are the weapons of the utterly downtrodden.

details: Guaranteed Drop: Abyssal Woods
→ Obtained from the killing the Madding Hand (NPC) in the Abyssal Woods, located south of the Woodland Trail Site of Grace.

notes: The Madding Hand cannot be buffed by spells or any consumables.
The Madding Hand cannot have its Ash of War or Affinity changed.
The Madding Hand's Unique Skill, Madding Spear-Hand Strike, deals 250 Madness build-up on hit, which can usually instantly inflict Madness on another Tarnished unless they have high Focus.

When Madness is inflicted within the general vicinity (7 meters) of user while they have the Madding Hand in an active weapon slot, they will receive a +7.5% (+5% in PvP) increase to their Attack Power for 30 seconds.
→ This buff stacks with the Aged One's Exultation and the Black Dumpling.
→ This buff activates even if the player doesn't meet the stat requirements for the weapon.
The Madding Hand shares the same heavy attacks with the Iron Ball and the Star Fist.
Increasing Strength and Dexterity will increase both the Physical and Fire Attack Power; increasing Intelligence and Faith will only increase the Fire Attack Power.
The Madness build-up is flat; it will not increase past 55 no matter the weapon level or stat investment.

skill.name: Sleep Evermore
skill.description: Pierces the enemy deeply with a poison-coated needle that delivers eternal sleep. If the follow-up strike lands upon a foe who is already in a state of slumber or eternal sleep, it will deal significant damage.

Concealed weapon used by Thiollier, of a design generally favored by poison-wielders for dark and subtle purposes.

Like St. Trina, who blossomed in the deep-purple garden, a rich poison is secreted from within which sends its victims into an eternal sleep.

skill.description: Grant the small dragon a fleeting glimpse of life and thrust it skyward, spewing flames over a wide frontward area.

The wielder's arm will take the form of a small dragon, sprouting sharp dragon fangs at the fist. This weapon cannot be two-handed.

The teachings of a group of spiritual seekers known as the Dryleaf Sect, revealed only to those of worthy valor and character. The practice of this martial art marks the dawn of an ascetic's journey.

weapons.description:

Perform a quickstep maneuver that allows for circling around lock-on targets.

weapons.description:
One of the weapons designed for gladiatorial combat. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum.

The black fang protruding from the bronze snake head is coated in deadly poison.

skill.name: Quickstep
skill.description:
Skill prized by the crafty and fleet of foot.
Perform a quickstep maneuver that allows for circling around lock-on targets.

weapons.description:
Claw comprised of two sharp, thin blades. Wielded by the assassins of ravenmount, this weapon allows them to imitate the attacks of Deathbirds.

Besides excelling at airborne attacks, its charge attack mimics the vicious swoop of a bird of prey.

details: Found inside Sage's Cave. They can be found inside a chest just beyond a room containing four skeletons, hidden behind an Illusory Wall.

estimate_if_undocumented.basis: 75 of 92 wiki-documented weapons with a non-unique skill use regular Smithing Stones

notes: As the in-game description suggests, the jump attacks of the Raptor Talons also deal roughly +10% damage when compared to the jump attacks of the same weapon class. This is due to the jump attacks of the Raptor Talons having a Motion Value of +30% compared to the more common Motion Values of +22% that the other Claws have.
The Raptor Talons have a unique two-handed strong attack where the player does a downward claw swipe for the first strong attack, and then an upward claw swipe for the second.
→ The uncharged heavy attacks are notably quick and true combo in PvP, making them very deadly.
→ When fully charged, the first attack will cause the player to lunge forward, and the second attack will make the player do a backflip.

→→ Despite its appearance, this is not considered a jump attack, and therefore does not receive a damage boost from the Claw Talisman, the Raptor's Black Feathers or the Gravebird's Blackquill Armor Shadow of the Erdtree.
The Raptor Talons have the lowest Attack Power out of all the Claws, though not by much. They are also the lightest.

Claws of a bottomless black from which no light can escape. Wielded by Anna, Swordhand of Night.

Engraved with a smithscript enabling strong attack to launch all three claws at a target. The blades are only semicorporeal, and cannot be fully guarded against.

details: Obtained from defeating the invading Swordhand of Night Anna on the approach to the hanging bell of the Finger Ruins.

→ The damage of the heavy attacks receive a boost from the Axe Talisman and the Smithing Talisman Shadow of the Erdtree.

Just like the Sword of Night Shadow of the Erdtree, the Claws of Night only scale with Dexterity.
→ Due to this, the Physical and Magic Attack Power of the Claws of Night are both increased when leveling up Dexterity.
The Claws of Night have a "feint attack" similar to Curved Swords, Heavy Thrusting Swords and Thrusting Swords; no other Claw has this attribute.

weapons.description:
Claw of a great red bear wielded without modification by Red Bear, whose name is lost to madness.

After killing the great red bear in a blood-soaked bout, he became fascinated by the untainted glory of its naked strength. "I wish to be a bear, no more, and no less."

details: Acquired from defeating the Red Bear NPC bossfight in the Northern Nameless Mausoleum.
